title: AI-Augmented Full Stack Developers — Claude Code Experts
description:
HIRING: 2 AI-Augmented Full Stack Developers — Claude Code Experts

We're Not a Startup. We're a $8M Company That Just Decided to Eat the Software Market.


Contract → Full-Time | Remote | 8 AM – 6 PM EST | Monday to Saturday - Start Immediately

First, Let's Talk About Why Your Current Gig Sucks

You already know this, but let's say it out loud:


1. You sit in meetings about meetings. Three hours of \"alignment sessions\" so six people can

approve a button color. Meanwhile, we ship entire features before lunch.


2. Your PRs rot in review queues for days. You wrote the code Monday. It's Thursday. Dave still hasn't looked at it. Dave is \"swamped.\" Here? PR goes up, gets reviewed same day, ships same day.


3. You're a cog and you know it. You own a slice of a microservice that serves a widget inside a dashboard that nobody uses. Here, you own entire product surfaces end-to-end — UI, API, database, deployment. Your name is on it.


4. The \"innovation\" is a lie. They said \"move fast and break things\" in the job post. What they meant was \"move at the speed of legal review and break nothing, ever, including your spirit.\" We actually move fast. Uncomfortably fast.


5. Your tools are chosen by committee. You're stuck on Jenkins pipelines from 2017 and a Jira board with 14 custom fields. We use Claude Code CLI, Linear, GitHub, Vercel, and that's about it. Clean. Fast. Done.


6. The tech debt is someone else's mess and now it's your problem. You inherited a codebase that looks like it was written by 47 different people across 3 continents over 6 years. Because it was. We're building from scratch with modern architecture and AI-first workflows.


7. You have zero ownership. You don't know the customers. You don't see the revenue. You don't feel the impact. Here, you'll watch real call center operators use what you built and hear them say \"this changes everything.\" That's not marketing copy — that's Tuesday.


8. Your compensation is \"competitive\" (it's not). They gave you a 3% raise and called it generous. We do competitive salary + performance bonuses + profit sharing + PTO. You want to write your own ticket? Prove you're an A-player and the money follows.


9. Nobody cares how fast you are. You could ship 10x what your team does and you'd get the same review score as the person who refactored a README. We measure output: PRs merged, features shipped, products launched. Speed is the currency here.


10. You're building someone else's dream. Some VP's pet project. Some board member's \"strategic initiative.\" Here, you're building products for an industry we've spent a decade mastering — and you get a real stake in the outcome.


Who We Are (And Why You Should Care)


I've spent 10 years building and owning call centers. Not advising them. Not consulting for them. Running them. We did $8 million last year in the call center world. We know every pain point, every inefficiency, every moment where operators think \"there has to be a better way.\"

Now there is. We're pivoting to SaaS — and we're building the software suite that the entire call center industry has been waiting for. AI-powered call routing, real-time analytics, agent management, voice AI integration — the whole stack.


Our position is unfair and we like it that way:

  • We have deep domain expertise (10 years, $8M revenue, real operator relationships)
  • We have cash flow — we're not burning runway praying for product-market fit
  • We're raising capital to pour fuel on the fire, but we don't need it to survive
  • We're using Claude Code CLI to build at 5-10x the speed of traditional teams
  • We're bringing our first product to market right now , with a full suite behind it


Two developers + Claude Code + a founder who knows the industry cold = a team that outproduces companies with 10x the headcount. That's not theory. That's the plan.


The Role: What You'll Actually Do Every Day


You'll use Claude Code CLI as your primary development tool , running parallel sessions across git worktrees while maintaining production-quality standards. This isn't \"use AI sometimes.\" This is AI-first development where you orchestrate multiple coding agents and own the output.


Daily work:

  • Build features end-to-end: UI → API → database → tests → deployment
  • Run 3–8 parallel Claude Code instances across worktrees
  • Write and maintain CLAUDE.md project files and agent configurations
  • Decompose features into agent-executable specifications
  • Review, test, and refine AI-generated code for production readiness
  • Ship 2–4 PRs per day (yes, per day)
  • Record quick Loom demos of shipped features


Tech stack:

  • TypeScript (primary), Python (secondary)
  • Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui
  • PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM, Redis
  • Vapi / LiveKit for voice AI
  • Vercel + Supabase for deployment
  • Claude Code CLI — this is the job


Must-Have Requirements (Non-Negotiable)

Experience & Skills:

  • 5+ years professional development experience
  • Deep Claude Code CLI proficiency — you should be able to show me your CLAUDE.md from a real project
  • Strong TypeScript + Python
  • React / Next.js production experience
  • PostgreSQL and data modeling chops
  • Git mastery: rebasing, worktrees, bisect, clean history — not just commit and push
  • Test-driven development habits
  • Excellent written English


Work Setup (No Exceptions):

  • High-end computer — your machine needs to handle multiple Claude Code instances, local dev servers, and Docker without breaking a sweat. If your laptop fans sound like a jet engine opening VS Code, this isn't the gig.
  • High-end internet — stable, fast connection. You're screen-sharing, pushing code, and running cloud deploys all day. Laggy internet = laggy output.
  • Available 8 AM – 6 PM EST, Monday –Saturday — 10-hour days. We work hard. I work 80-hour weeks. I'm asking you for 60. That's the deal.
  • Reliability is everything — show up, communicate, deliver. Every day. No disappearing acts.


Communication is IMPERATIVE:


This cannot be overstated. You need to be a clear, proactive communicator. Daily async standups. Responsive on Slack. Articulate in PRs. If something's blocked, you say so immediately — not two days later. We're a small, fast team. Communication gaps don't just slow us down, they kill momentum.


The Transparency Section

We use time tracking software. Not because we're micromanagers — because we're building trust with accountability. Honest work gets honest pay. Simple.


You work 10-hour days. Monday through Saturday, 8 AM to 6 PM EST. This is a high-intensity, high-output role. We're bringing a product to market and building a suite behind it. If you want work-life balance right now, I respect that, but this isn't the role. If you want to build something massive and get rewarded for it, keep reading.


We move at startup speed with real-company cash. That means you get the excitement of building from zero without the anxiety of wondering if payroll clears next month.

What You Get


Competitive salary — real money, not \"equity only\"

Performance bonuses — ship fast, get paid more. Directly tied to output.

Profit sharing — we win, you win. Not a poster on the wall. Real checks.

️ Paid time off — because burned-out developers write burned-out code

title: Full Stack Engineer (React.js / RoR)
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Full Stack Engineer with 3+ years of experience in React.js, TypeScript, and Ruby on Rails to join the core development team of our U.S. client. You will design, build, and deliver the best financial software on the planet!


Our client is a fintech company that provides commodities managers with task automation and timely insights on their trades, including risk exposure, positions, and profits and losses. With over 5 million trades on its SaaS platform, the company is an award-winning industry leader that counts some of the world's largest financial firms as customers. Our client is growing rapidly and is looking for smart, bold risk-takers to further its product strategy of market disruption and expansion.


Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and test new features for the clients next-gen trading platform
  • Write efficient, maintainable, and reusable code
  • Utilize AI tooling, such as Cursor and CodeRabbit, to accelerate software development
  • Participate in and support the full continuous testing and delivery pipeline
  • Join the engineering support rotation, assisting the Customer Success team
  • Write and maintain unit, integration, and feature tests
  • Review code and tests written by other team members
  • Identify and eliminate technical debt
  • Accept, act on, and provide feedback in a timely manner
  • Seek and provide timely technical assistance and clarification.
  • Collaborate with and mentor team members
  • Learn new technologies (and help your teammates learn them too)
  • Support the clients growth by contributing to open-source projects and representing the client within the developer community


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and teamwork skills
  • 3+ years of experience developing full stack applications with React.js and Ruby on Rails
  • Experience with TypeScript, SQL-compliant databases, Go, Python, or other open-source and commercial technologies, such as Kafka and RabbitMQ
  • Proficient in the use of AI tooling such as Cursor and GitHub CoPilot
  • Experience with high-volume, event-based system architectures and Agile software development practices
  • A self-disciplined, task-oriented approach to development, testing, and code structure
  • Desire to work in an environment that:
  • Embraces diversity
  • Maintains a client-centric approach to building products
  • Strives to maintain a world-class organization
  • Loves technology
  • Gives back to the community
  • Proven ability to stay self-motivated, work hard, own problems from start to finish, and bring order from chaos
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently or as part of a broader team.
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, transparent, and fun


Preferred Experience

  • University degree in Computer Science, a related field of study, or equivalent experience
  • Experience in finance and/or energy, commodities, or equity trading
  • Experience with enterprise-grade software and highly secure, multi-tenant SaaS solutions
  • Experience with Docker and Kubernetes
  • Experience with real-time, data-streaming technologies such as Kafka
  • Experience with Ember


Additional Information

  • Know that your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • Own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart, creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them and be transparent!
  • Be recognized as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

Collaborating with the world's leading sawmills, we play a pivotal role in supporting the shift to a carbon-neutral future. title: Pessoa Cientista de Dados - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas LGBTQIAPN+
description:
A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office.

Quem somos:

Nós da Artefact LatAm acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact!

Quais serão suas responsabilidades:

Você se juntará à nossa equipe de Dados e Consultoria, que ajuda os clientes a transformar e melhorar sua estratégia de dados aplicando análises avançadas para gerar insights que criam valor de negócio a partir de big data e inteligência artificial.

  • Inovar . Você trabalhará com sua equipe, composta por consultores, cientistas de dados, e engenheiros, para identificar as necessidades dos clientes e definir soluções inovadoras.
  • Aprender e Compartilhar. Você trabalhará em uma equipe colaborativa que promove o compartilhamento de conhecimento. Você aprenderá com outras pessoas, compartilhará conhecimento e ficará a par das novidades/atualizações do setor.
  • Desenvolver. Você participará da solução do início ao fim. Com o auxílio de cientistas seniores você gerenciará a concepção e a implementação, além de otimizar o desempenho e a escalabilidade.
  • Atuar em toda a cadeia de valor dos projetos (coleta e tratamento de dados, análise exploratória de dados, aplicação de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, produtização de modelos)
  • Popularizar termos técnicos ou soluções para perfis mais orientados a negócios, pode trabalhar em uma equipe com perfis muito diversificados
  • Priorizar suas tarefas, respeitar prazos e se levantar a mão em caso de riscos ou problemas

O que nós estamos procurando:

Ter cursado um curso de graduação em ciência de dados, aprendizado de máquina, matemática, ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.

  • Desejável um primeiro conhecimento em estatística e programação (Python/R).
  • Curiosidade: você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes, você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor
  • Colaboração : o compartilhamento de conhecimento é essencial para você e você participa ativamente da difusão de informações dentro da Artefact
  • Empreendedorismo : você traz soluções, novas ideias, inovações

O que oferecemos:

  • VR/VT
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
  • Gympass
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós:

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da área de dados.
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender.
  • Cultura: Empatia e Colaboração está no nosso DNA.
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!

Junte-se a nós!

title: Application Support - Dynatrace (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What will you be doing:

  • Providing application support and monitoring using Dynatrace;
  • Troubleshooting and resolving issues in Linux-based environments;
  • Ensuring observability and performance optimization of applications;
  • Collaborating with development and infrastructure teams to enhance system reliability;
  • Writing and executing SQL queries for data analysis and issue resolution;
  • Establishing best practices for application performance and monitoring;



What are we looking for?

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or similar;
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in Application Support, with at least 3 years of Dynatrace experience;
  • Experience with Linux environments;
  • SQL knowledge (other database experience is also considered);
  • Experience in Observability/Monitoring tools (Dynatrace preferred);
  • Java knowledge is a plus;
  • Minimum B2 level in English (written and spoken), and Portuguese ;
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills;
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and collaborate with cross-functional teams;
  • Hybrid work model: available to work in Porto or Lisbon;
  • Mandatory availability to relocate (from Brazil to Portuga l).



What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid setting based in Lisbon or Porto.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV to: .

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: Investment Banking Intern
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.


We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.


Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.


What You'll Gain:

  • Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
  • 3-Statement Financial Modeling
  • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
  • Trading Comparables (Comps)
  • Precedent Transactions
  • Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques
  • Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
  • Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:
  • Pitch Book Development
  • Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence
  • Industry and Company Research
  • And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
  • Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.


This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.


Who We're Looking For:

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.


How to Apply:

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.

This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: AWS Data Scientist | Senior (Remote)
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Atuar no desenvolvimento e evolução de soluções de Ciência de Dados e IA Generativa, com foco em arquiteturas RAG;
  • Executar demandas priorizadas pelo Product Owner, realizando detalhamento técnico e definição de abordagens de Machine Learning e GenAI;
  • Desenvolver, sustentar e monitorar pipelines de dados, modelos de ML, APIs e fluxos de IA;
  • Validar performance de sistemas RAG;
  • Implementar pipelines de ingestão e indexação de textos em bancos vetoriais;
  • Construir APIs e fluxos utilizando LangChain, LangGraph e integrações com OpenAI e AWS Bedrock;
  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações conteinerizadas e arquiteturas serverless em AWS e Azure;
  • Produzir visualizações e indicadores para análise crítica e validação de resultados;
  • Garantir aderência às diretrizes de arquitetura, segurança, escalabilidade e boas práticas em nuvem.



Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência sólida com Python e bibliotecas Pandas, scikit-learn, TensorFlow e PyTorch;
  • Experiência prática com Modelos de Linguagem de Grande Escala (LLMs), soluções de IA Generativa e arquiteturas RAG;
  • Conhecimento em métricas de avaliação de NLP e IA (similaridade semântica, BLEU, ROUGE);
  • Experiência com serviços de nuvem AWS, incluindo os serviços: S3, Lambda, RDS, SageMaker, Parameter Store e Secret Manager;
  • Desenvolvimento de pipelines em bancos vetoriais (AWS OpenSearch);
  • Construção de APIs utilizando LangChain e LangGraph;
  • Integrações com OpenAI e AWS Bedrock;
  • Uso de Azure Document Intelligence para processamento de documentos.

Desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento em DevOps aplicado a ML/IA (MLOps).

title: Customer Success Agent (Technical, 24/7 Operations)
description:
Customer Success Agent (Technical, 24/7 Operations)


TG Lab is a technology company powering some of the biggest winners in sports betting and online casino products. We provide player account management and engagement technology to industry leaders such as Stake.com, Belgium National Lottery, Betsson Group , and many others. Our innovative yet practical solutions fuel world-class real-money wagering technology that supports over 1 million players. Our iGaming software is designed for distribution to casino and sportsbook operators across the EU, USA , and Asia.


We’re looking for a Customer Success Manager (Technical) to join our 24/7 operations team, which operates at the core of platform stability, partner communication, and incident handling. In this role, you’ll work on the frontline monitoring platform health, investigating issues, and coordinating real-time responses to ensure stable and reliable operations for our partners. This role is about real-time reaction, investigation, coordination, and clear communication.


Responsibilities:  


  • Actively monitor platform health and alerts during your shift and react to incidents in real time
  • Investigate partner-raised issues and perform first-level technical analysis using logs and monitoring dashboards
  • Communicate clearly with partners during incidents, outages, and escalations
  • Own issues throughout their full life cycle: detection, investigation, coordination, and resolution
  • Create and manage Jira tickets and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams
  • Provide transparent updates internally and externally
  • Identify recurring issues and risks that may impact platform stability
  • Maintain accurate documentation and structured internal communication


Requirements:


  • Junior to early-mid level profile 
  • Strong written and verbal English skills
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-responsibility environment
  • Logical, analytical thinker with a structured approach to problem solving
  • Technically curious and comfortable working with system behavior, logs, and monitoring tools
  • Experience or familiarity with Jira, Slack, or similar tools
  • Able to work shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays, as part of a 24/7 rotation
  • Calm under pressure and confident handling incidents and escalations


Things we consider as an advantage:


  • Experience in Customer Support, Customer Success, Technical Support, NOC, or Operations
  • Experience with monitoring tools
  • Exposure to SaaS, platform-based products, or iGaming
  • Basic understanding of web technologies, APIs, or backend systems


Working with us implies:


  • Memorable company parties and social activities like team buildings and monthly birthday celebrations.
  • Working in a company with a global culture, experience, and reach.
  • Working on-site in our modern, bright, and comfortable office space located in downtown Foz do Iguaçu, with a great working atmosphere, a collaborative team of amazing people, and open-minded managers.
  • Opportunities to build valuable skills, work with unique and interesting projects for the sports industry, express and implement your ideas and grow your career.


The monthly salary range will depend on the selected candidate's experience and skills.

We will contact only shortlisted candidates.

title: Salesforce Consultant / Developer
description:
We are seeking a skilled Salesforce Consultant or Developer (minimum 8-10 years of experience) to join our expanding AMS support and Project Delivery team for a leading US-based client. The role requires strong Salesforce expertise in consulting and/or development, excellent communication skills, and the ability to deliver high-quality support and enhancements.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve system issues in a timely manner.

  • Experience with integration tools and APIs.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

Extensive expertise in some of the following areas:

description:

title: Data Scientist / Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Data Scientist / Machine Learning Engineer

(Mid–Senior Level)

12 month contract

Remote


Overview

We are looking for an experienced Data Scientist / Machine Learning Engineer to design, build, and deploy production-grade ML models while supporting the backend infrastructure required to run them at scale. This is a hands-on role combining applied machine learning, cloud engineering, and data pipeline development, with a strong focus on AI Content Moderation and Recommendation Engine systems.


Key Responsibilities


Take ownership of end-to-end ML production deployment, building and shipping new models largely from scratch, with responsibility for architecture, deployment pipelines, and operational reliability in collaboration with backend engineering.


  • Design, train, deploy, and maintain machine learning models for production use, including AI Content Moderation and Recommendation Engine features
  • Build and integrate backend infrastructure to support ML models and data pipelines
  • Work with cloud-based systems to manage model training, deployment, and monitoring
  • Improve data ingestion pipelines and feature engineering processes
  • Develop scalable, reliable ML services in collaboration with backend engineering
  • Collaborate closely with engineering and product teams to gather requirements and deliver solutions
  • Communicate progress proactively and contribute to technical decision-making


Required Experience

  • 3+ years of professional experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, or AI-related roles
  • Strong Python proficiency for ML development and data processing
  • Hands-on experience building and deploying ML models into production environments
  • 2+ years of practical experience working with AWS infrastructure
  • Solid background in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related technical discipline

  • Python (advanced)

  • Experience building content moderation systems and/or recommendation engines
  • AWS (deployment and infrastructure management), including:
  • AWS Lambda
  • AWS SQS
  • AWS DynamoDB
  • AWS Kinesis or Kafka
  • Experience with at least one ML framework:
  • PyTorch or TensorFlow

  • Proatividade e autonomia

description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value


A transformação digital ajuda as empresas a atingirem seu potencial máximo - se as tecnologias funcionarem para as pessoas que as utilizam! Estamos em busca de um profissional qualificado para atuar na integração de sistemas SAP, garantindo conectividade eficiente entre diferentes plataformas e aplicações empresariais. O candidato ideal terá experiência em arquiteturas de integração, desenvolvimento de interfaces e uso de ferramentas específicas do ecossistema SAP, e deve ter inglês em nível avançado para atuação em projetos internacionais.


Principais Responsabilidades


  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter integrações entre o SAP e outros sistemas (internos e externos).
  • Trabalhar com middleware e tecnologias de integração como SAP PI/PO, SAP CPI, BTP, API Management e Web Services (SOAP/REST).
  • Implementar e monitorar processos de troca de dados via IDocs, RFCs, OData e BAPIs.
  • Garantir a segurança, escalabilidade e eficiência das integrações.
  • Colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento, infraestrutura e negócio para alinhar soluções às necessidades estratégicas da empresa.
  • Identificar e solucionar problemas de integração, otimizando processos e garantindo alta disponibilidade.
  • Criar e manter documentação técnica e boas práticas de integração.


Requisitos:


  • Experiência comprovada com integração de sistemas SAP.
  • Conhecimento avançado em SAP PI/PO, SAP CPI (Cloud Platform Integration), API Management e Web Services.
  • Experiência com IDocs, RFCs, OData e BAPIs.
  • Familiaridade com protocolos de comunicação e formatos de dados como XML, JSON, EDIFACT e CSV.
  • Conhecimento em ABAP, Java, JavaScript ou Groovy para customizações de integração.
  • Experiência com arquitetura orientada a serviços (SOA) e microsserviços.
  • Inglês avançado/fluente para atuação em projetos internacionais.


Diferenciais (Desejável):


  • Certificações SAP em integração (ex.: SAP Certified Development Associate - SAP Integration Suite).
  • Experiência com SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform).
  • Conhecimento em integrações com SAP S/4HANA, SuccessFactors, Ariba, C/4HANA e outras soluções SAP.


Regime de contratação: CLT

100% Remoto


Liberte todo o seu potencial e engenhosidade – molde o seu próprio futuro. Somos mais do que apenas um local de trabalho; somos uma incubadora de talentos. Com diversos caminhos e oportunidades de aprendizado e carreira de longo prazo, oferecemos inúmeras maneiras de realizar seus sonhos.


*Todas as vagas da NTT DATA são destinadas também para pessoas com deficiência.

title: Revenue Operations Associate
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.


What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.

From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention

If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.


About SpendHound:

  • SpendHound is a 100% free software renewal management platform and service recently launched by the research firm YipitData. (See this introductory video from SpendHound’s Senior Product Manager!)
  • SpendHound is the single source of truth for companies’ renewal information and includes:
  • A comprehensive view of all software applications used with annual contract values, auto-renewal information, renewal dates, license counts, and more
  • An invoice and contract management system for companies to store their invoices and contracts
  • Renewal reminders through email and Slack so companies never miss upcoming software renewals
  • Free advice from procurement experts to discuss price benchmarking insights and negotiation strategies for any upcoming renewals
  • Companies use the SpendHound platform and procurement expert service to save time and money on their software renewals.
  • SpendHound is free for customers because customer data is de-identified, aggregated with other panelists, and used as part of YipitData market research (example report ).


About The Role:

Are you a collaborative consulting, analytics, or operations professional with 3+ years of experience, passionate about building a world-class revenue team?

We are seeking a Revenue Operations Associate to play a crucial role in our fast-growing team, SpendHound. As a fast-growing “start-up” within a larger organization, this is a unique opportunity for someone with a strong operational mindset to come in and help build something truly special.


We expect East work hours.


As our Revenue Operations Associate, you will partner with our Sales and Marketing teams to:

  • Be an operations subject matter expert for the Sales function, working closely with RevOps and Spendhound leadership to support Sales and execute on key initiatives
  • Implement processes and solutions that can streamline revenue acquisition and eliminate inefficiencies
  • Maintain and measure various components of the Sales process, such as
  • Target/Territory Management
  • Lead Generation, and
  • Outbound Cadence Operations.
  • Ensure that the Sales teams are operating seamlessly through data evaluation and by improving workflows


You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • Operations professional with 3+ years of experience, passionate about building a world-class revenue team.
  • You demonstrate a high aptitude for organization, process development, project and change management, and analytics
  • You have advanced Excel skills
  • Your experience with CRMs such as Salesforce.com
  • You are willing to become proficient in SQL and data management
  • You are a natural problem-solver, with a keen eye for detail and spotting issues
  • You have advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)
  • You are committed to continuously improving yourself and helping those around you


What We Offer:

  • Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package
  • Remote work
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. See more on our high-impact, high-opportunity work environment above!



Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (Node.js)
description:

Working closely with product stakeholders, you will play an integral role in building an industry-leading product.

title: CLM Functional Support Analyst
description:
About UST


Born digital, UST transforms lives through the power of technology. We walk alongside our clients and partners, embedding innovation and agility into everything they do. We help them create transformative experiences and human-centered solutions for a better world.

UST is a mission-driven organization where people, purpose, and technology come together to create meaningful impact. With a strong people-first culture, we empower our teams to innovate, collaborate, and grow while delivering value to our clients and communities worldwide.



We 're looking for aCLM Functional Support Analyst to provides functional support for Contract Lifecycle Management platforms, handling incidents and service requests, supporting end users, and ensuring smooth contract operations across legal, procurement, and business teams.


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide functional support for CLM-related incidents and service requests (L1/L2).
  • Log, categorize, prioritize, and track tickets using ITSM tools.
  • Perform initial troubleshooting and functional analysis before escalating to L2/L3 or technical teams.
  • Support users with contract creation, templates, clause libraries, approval workflows, and role-based access.
  • Perform basic CLM system configuration (templates, fields, workflows, user roles).
  • Monitor CLM integrations with ERP/CRM systems and identify data synchronization issues.
  • Support UAT activities, regression testing, and release validation.
  • Maintain user documentation and knowledge base articles.
  • Provide end-user training and onboarding support.
  • Ensure SLA compliance and provide basic reporting on ticket trends.


Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in CLM functional support or functional analysis roles.
  • Strong understanding of contract lifecycle processes and legal/procurement workflows.
  • Experience with CLM platforms such as Icertis, Agiloft, Conga, Sirion, SAP Ariba, or similar.
  • Experience working with ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira).
  • Basic understanding of ERP/CRM integrations.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Advanced in English (B2+)


Why Join UST?

At UST, you will work in a collaborative and inclusive environment where innovation, learning, and personal growth are encouraged. You will have the opportunity to contribute to impactful projects, work with global teams, and build solutions that truly make a difference.


Equal Opportunity Statement

UST is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Equity Employer . We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

title: Software Engineer Sênior - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas LGBTQIAPN+
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.
Quem nós somos

Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact !
Quais serão suas atividades;
Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.    
Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:  

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando JavaScript/TypeScript e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js , priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance. 
  • Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB) , com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.  
  • Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem , configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.      
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar :  transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.      
  • Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.  
  • Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.


O que nós estamos procurando;    

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.      
  • Experiência solida (+5 anos):  em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, JavaScript e TypeScript.     
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.      
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD , uso de Docker , Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
  • Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.  
  • Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).


O que oferecemos;       

  • VR/VT       
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)       
  • Gympass       
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico       
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)       
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)      
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)       

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;       

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados       
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender       
  • Cultura: junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar       
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!       

Junte-se a nós!

title: Senior Manager, Regional Key Account Management
description:

Ability to understand unique customer supply chain requirements and drive a particular sector focus

Need to support other China-Brazil sales leads and Chinese projects/business

  • Excellent presentation skills.
  • Fluent in both Chinese and English
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook);

title: Data Scientist - Catálogo
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro , maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina , e a Fisia , distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Buscamos uma pessoa Cientista de Dados para atuar na squad de Catálogo , com foco em qualidade, enriquecimento e padronização de dados de produtos, utilizando técnicas de Inteligência artificial.

Essa posição tem papel estratégico na evolução do catálogo como ativo central do negócio, atuando desde a definição de hipóteses até a implementação, experimentação e mensuração de impacto, com forte interface com Produto, Engenharia, Design e Negócio.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e evoluir soluções baseadas em IA e Machine Learning para enriquecimento automático de produtos, como:
  • Padronização de descrições e títulos
  • Inferência e sugestão de atributos
  • Classificação e reclassificação de produtos


  • Atuar na definição e otimização de:
  • Modelos e regras de categorização de produtos
  • Estratégias de enriquecimento e validação automática de atributos
  • Métricas de qualidade de catálogo (completude, consistência, acurácia e unicidade)


  • Trabalhar com modelos supervisionados e não supervisionados, incluindo abordagens baseadas em NLP e LLMs, quando aplicável.
  • Avaliar e evoluir métricas que conectem qualidade de catálogo com impacto em negócio e experiência do usuário (ex: conversão, busca, recomendação).
  • Conduzir testes A/B e experimentos controlados para validar o impacto das melhorias de enriquecimento e qualidade do catálogo.
  • Traduzir problemas de negócio e operacionais em soluções analíticas e modelos de dados escaláveis.
  • Atuar em parceria com Engenharia, Produto e áreas de negócio na definição do roadmap técnico de catálogo.
  • Garantir boas práticas de ciência de dados: versionamento, documentação, reprodutibilidade e monitoramento das soluções baseadas em IA.
  • Apoiar tecnicamente outros cientistas de dados do time, elevando o nível das discussões técnicas e decisões analíticas.


Requisitos necessários:

  • Formação superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência comprovada de 5 a 7 anos em projetos de ciência de dados.
  • Experiência prática com problemas de classificação, enriquecimento ou qualidade de dados.
  • Forte domínio de SQL para análise de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Proficiência em Python para análise de dados, experimentação e modelagem.
  • Experiência com modelos de machine learning aplicados a dados estruturados.
  • Vivência com experimentação e testes A/B em ambientes de produto digital.
  • Experiência com ambientes de dados em nuvem (ex: BigQuery, data lakes).
  • Capacidade de comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Experiência em produtos digitais com alto volume e complexidade de dados.
  • Noções de MLOps.
  • Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência prévia com catálogo de produtos, e-commerce ou marketplace.
  • Conhecimento em modelagem de dados e governança de dados.
  • Vivência com detecção de anomalias e métricas de qualidade de dados.
  • Experiência com pipelines de dados e integração entre sistemas.
  • Conhecimento em NLP aplicado a dados de produtos (ex: normalização de descrições, extração de atributos).
  • Conhecimento em visualização de dados e storytelling analítico.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de business intelligence, como Power BI.


Perfil esperado:

  • Forte mentalidade de qualidade de dados como produto.
  • Perfil analítico, curioso e orientado a impacto de negócio.
  • Autonomia para conduzir iniciativas complexas de ponta a ponta.
  • Capacidade de influenciar decisões técnicas e de produto com dados.
  • Boa colaboração em times multidisciplinares.

title: Wordpress Plugin & Full Stack Developer
description:
Please only apply if you are familiar with Wordpress Plugin Development, with strong PHP skills in additional to being a full stack (front and back) developer. Ideally you should also be comfortable with mobile apps and figuring out and doing different things in tech and thrive in a fast-paced fluid environment.


Do you love technology puzzles and figuring out how to make a variety of things to work? Are you great at catching mistakes through user testing for quality assurance? Are you a dedicated, resourceful team player with strong problem solving skills? Do you have experience working with numerous different technology platforms in digital form, ranging from CRMs (like Constant Contact, Aweber, Beehiiv), Hosting (AWS, WHM), DNS (Cloudflare), Automtions (like zapier, make.com), project management (like jira.com)?


Detail oriented test and php / elementor test REQUIRED before video interview.


About Us

Life Water Media specializes in digital branding and awareness campaigns for publicly traded companies in the United States stock market and other large scale projects. We started in 2019. We internally own 10 newsletter brands, a mobile app, and other digital assets.


Responsibilities

  • Focus on building out custom wordpress plugins for internal agency needs
  • Focus on connecting marketing data for purposes of analysis, can range from open rates in crm, to costs on paid media platforms, to click through data on sms provider.
  • Setting up CRM lists, automations, and funnels from start to finish with script, reporting and directly on the platforms.
  • Willing to have a flexible set of responsibilities to service whatever is required in daily operations, including posting daily new article first thing in the mornings.
  • Work hand-in-hand with CTO and CMO on various directives. If you see a way to do it better, we'd love to hear it.
  • Handle multiple projects from start to finish, adhering to set deadlines set by CTO or CMO.
  • Doing or setting up manual/automated reporting related to adspend, subscriber counts, open rates, cost per lead, etc
  • Copying, testing, and fixing Elementor landing pages and ensuring they are properly connected to CRM, SMS, webhooks, etc.
  • Copying, testing, fixing PHP scripts ensuring they are properly connected to CRM, SMS provider, webhooks, postbacks, etc.
  • On CRM set up lists/segments, automations for the welcome emails, templates, list cleaning,
  • Doing specific weekly and monthly audits of our 10 newsletter landing page and script funnels.
  • Testing and helping manage our mobile app.
  • Test Planning and Execution:  Design and implement test plans, scenarios, and procedures to test software functionality. 
  • Defect Management:  Identify, document, and track software defects (that you can't fix), then work with developers to ensure they are corrected before release
  • Collaboration:  Communicate and collaborate with developers, product managers, and other team members to understand requirements and provide feedback on usability and functionality. 
  • Automation:  Code and implement automated test scripts using various tools and frameworks. 
  • Quality Standards:  Create and enforce guidelines for software quality standards within the company. 


Qualifications

  • Proficient in Wordpress, Elementor, PHP, HTML/CSS
  • Strong communication, conceptual thinking, problem solving skills
  • Deadline and detail-oriented
  • Self Starter who can be self-taught and work without much direction
  • Works well in collaboration with a team and independently.
  • Must have the ability to multitask, in a VERY fast paced work environment.
  • This position requires a personality that can accept constructive criticism, change directions rapidly and accept new assignments frequently with pressing deadlines.


Compensation

Salary: based on your experience level


To Apply Submit:

  • Current resume
  • Synopsis of recent salary history
  • If selected, you'll receive invite to a couple skills test before video interview


Requirements Before Employment

  • Signed Confidentiality agreement
  • Signed Non-compete agreement
  • Signed Contract & W-8 BEN tax form


Company Culture

  • Remote
  • We're playful, tight nit, friendly, family-oriented atmosphere.
  • We're very loyal, focused, dedicated and hard-working.
  • Hours 8AM - 5PM, Mon-Fri, with certain US holidays included

description:

Especialista Jurídico


Qualidade para Vida - Esta é a visão de negócio da GMReis, que há mais de 25 anos desenvolve, produz e comercializa sua linha de produtos, classificada em próteses ortopédicas.

Área: Jurídico

Reporte: CEO

Descrição do Cargo

Atuar como Especialista Jurídico, prestando apoio técnico direto ao CEO, com foco na leitura, análise e revisão de contratos empresariais, inclusive em língua inglesa, contribuindo para a mitigação de riscos e suporte à tomada de decisão da Diretoria.

Atuar como ponto focal jurídico da empresa, realizando análises jurídicas preliminares e intermediando, de forma técnica, as demandas junto a escritórios e consultorias jurídicas externas.

  • Apoiar áreas internas em temas jurídicos, conforme diretrizes da Diretoria.

  • Formação superior completa em Direito;


  • OAB ativa;


  • Experiência prática com contratos empresariais;


  • Capacidade comprovada de leitura, interpretação e análise de contratos em inglês;

  • Perfil técnico, analítico e criterioso;


  • Discrição, ética profissional e capacidade de atuação próxima à alta liderança.


  • Residir em Campinas ou Sumaré, Paulínia, Hortolândia ou Valinhos.


Benefícios:

  • Vale Refeição
  • Vale Alimentação
  • Vale transporte ou auxílio combustível
  • Convênio médico coparticipativo (para o colaborador (a)
  • Convênio odontológico para colaborador e dependentes
  • Parceria com a faculdade Esamc descontos de até 50% na mensalidade para graduações e tecnólogos e 20% para MBA.

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including:
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral;
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels;
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons, and counterparty exposures;
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institution limits and capital requirements;
  • Net-worth monitoring.
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.

Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
  • not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

The platform simplifies the discovery, validation, and scaling of vendors, tools, and data solutions, reducing the time, risk, and cost associated with adopting fintech solutions.

Job Description:

Our client is seeking a Finance & Operations Manager to work closely with the CFO and take ownership of day-to-day finance and selected operational responsibilities. • Support the CFO with financial planning, KPI tracking, and preparation of investor materials.

• Maintain and update financial forecasts and cash flow models.

• Support international expansion initiatives from a finance and compliance perspective.

• Assist with operational responsibilities, including contributing to SOC 2 and ISO certification processes.

• Identify process improvements across Finance and Operations and implement practical solutions.

• Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent).

• Proven experience consolidating multiple entities into one set of accounts.

• Strong experience leading month-end close processes and managing bookkeeping.

• Experience in fast-paced or high-growth environments.

• Strong attention to detail with a high level of reliability and diligence.

• Ability to work autonomously and balance multiple priorities effectively.

Preferred Skills:

• Experience maintaining and updating financial forecasts and cash flow models.

• Experience with cap table management software and compliance processes.

• Exposure to supporting audit, certification, or regulatory processes (e.g., SOC 2, ISO).

Personality:

• Hands-on and proactive, with a willingness to take ownership.

• Comfortable operating both at a detailed level and in strategic discussions.

• Flexible working style with strong organizational skills.

• Collaborative and adaptable in a scaling business environment.

Software & Tools:

• Accounting and bookkeeping software.

• Financial forecasting and cash flow modeling tools.

• Cap table management software.

• Compliance and certification tracking tools (SOC 2, ISO).

English Level:

C2

Schedule:

Part-Time UK Business Hours

• Payment in USD or Local Currency according to candidate's preference.

• Opportunity to play a pivotal role in shaping the finance function within a high-growth company.

• Supportive and collaborative working environment.

title: Graphic Designer (Toys and Baby Gear)
description:
About Us:

Move2Play is a rapidly growing kids toy company in the e-commerce space. We were founded with a mission to create unique, interactive toys that get kids moving. We're a small but enthusiastic team that likes to work hard, move quickly, and bring thoughtful, engaging products to families across the country.


As we continue to grow, we’re looking for a talented Graphic Designer to help shape the visual identity of our products from concept to shelf.


Job Description:

We are seeking a talented and detail-oriented Graphic Designer to join our team. This role focuses on graphic design execution for toys and baby gear products — including packaging, print artwork, character illustration, surface graphics, color studies, and visual concept development.


The ideal candidate has strong illustration skills, a sharp eye for color and composition, and experience creating graphics that resonate with both kids and modern parents. This is not an industrial design or soft goods design role — it is a graphics-first position embedded within product development.


**Portfolio or personal website is required.

**Professional fluency in English (written and spoken) is required.


Salary:

30-40K USD | 5-15% Bonus



Responsibilities:

  • Create original character illustrations and playful graphics for toys and baby products
  • Develop surface artwork for products (prints, patterns, decals, labels, etc.)
  • Conduct color studies and create cohesive color palettes across product lines
  • Prepare production-ready print files and packaging dielines
  • Collaborate closely with product designers, brand designers, engineers, and overseas manufacturers to ensure accurate execution
  • Develop instruction manuals, inserts, and other printed collateral
  • Design engaging retail packaging, including layout, typography, callouts, and compliance elements
  • Contribute to new product concepts with visual mockups and graphic direction
  • Maintain brand consistency across all product graphics
  • Stay up-to-date on design trends in toys, baby gear, illustration, and packaging
  • *Leverage AI platforms to enhance and expand design design tasks


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Illustration, or related field
  • 4+ years of experience in graphic design - experience in toys, baby products, or other consumer products is required.
  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator and Photoshop required; InDesign strongly preferred)
  • Strong illustration skills (vector and/or hand-drawn style)
  • Experience preparing print-ready files and working with packaging dielines
  • Solid understanding of typography, color theory, and composition
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and move quickly in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong attention to detail and organization
  • Experience working with overseas manufacturers is a plus
  • Passion for children’s products and understanding of what appeals to both kids and parents
  • *Experience working with AI platforms to improve design outputs


Nice-to-Haves:

  • Experience designing retail packaging for Amazon or mass retail
  • Experience with character development and brand mascots
  • Familiarity with basic 3D mockups or rendering tools
  • Understanding of toy safety labeling requirements
  • Experience working with licensed IP


Benefits:

  • Fully remote position
  • Competitive salary based on experience
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Creative and collaborative work environment
  • Opportunity to directly shape products sold nationally and internationally


  • If you’re a graphic designer who loves illustration, packaging, and creating playful yet beautiful products for kids and families, we’d love to hear from you!

title: CRO & Shopify Developer
description:
CRO & Shopify Developer

  • Full time contractor
  • £22-32k per year (depending on experience).
  • Bonus structure on performance


About PM Digital

PM Digital is The full-funnel CRO & Performance agency for 7, 8, and 9-figure DTC brands. We optimise & fix entire funnels. Our focus is increasing profitability for ecommerce brands and you are part of this through the CRO split testing and Shopify development for our client stores.


About the Role

We're looking for a CRO & Shopify Developer to join one of our pods. You'll work alongside CRO strategists, designers, and copywriters to build high-converting landing pages, implement A/B tests, and bring Figma designs to life in Shopify.

This isn't a \"fix bugs and update plugins\" role. You'll be building conversion-focused pages from scratch, implementing split tests, and directly impacting revenue for DTC brands spending serious money on paid acquisition.


What You'll Do

  • Build landing pages, PDPs, and funnel pages in Shopify based on Figma designs
  • Implement A/B and multivariate tests using Convert.com and Intelligems
  • Set up price testing, offer testing, and bundle experiments via Intelligems
  • Work within our internal app and processes to ship work on time
  • Translate designer and strategist intent into pixel-perfect, fast-loading pages
  • Ensure all builds are mobile-first, performance-optimised, and QA'd before launch
  • Collaborate daily with your pod (CRO strategist, designer, copywriter)
  • Flag technical limitations or opportunities early — don't wait until it's a problem
  • Document your work clearly so others can maintain and iterate on it


What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years Shopify development experience (themes, Liquid, custom sections)
  • ADVANCED use of AI Within your development workflow. Speed is key.
  • Strong HTML, CSS, JavaScript — you can build from scratch, not just edit templates
  • Experience turning Figma designs into production-ready Shopify pages
  • Familiarity with A/B testing platforms (Intelligems, Convert.com, or similar)
  • Understanding of page speed optimisation and Core Web Vitals
  • Comfortable working async in a remote team across time zones
  • Strong written communication, you'll be working with non-developers daily
  • Attention to detail, sloppy work doesn't ship
  • Strong AI Use case to speed up time to delivery


What Success Looks Like

  • Pages go live on time, match the design, and perform well
  • Tests are implemented correctly the first time — no re-work loops
  • You proactively flag issues and suggest better solutions
  • Your pod trusts you to execute without hand-holding


You'll Thrive Here If You:

  • Want ownership, not tickets
  • Care about the outcome (revenue), not just the output (code)
  • Move fast and communicate clearly
  • Take pride in clean, maintainable work
  • Want to grow with a high-performance team


You Won't Thrive Here If You:

  • Need constant direction or detailed specs for every task
  • See QA as someone else's problem
  • Struggle with direct feedback
  • Don't hit deadlines


Details

  • Remote (European time zone based)
  • Full-time contractor
  • Salary based on experience - £22-34k BOE


How to Apply

Send a short note on why this role fits you, plus:

  • Link to 2-3 Shopify websites or experiences you've built (landing pages or custom work preferred)
  • Brief explanation of a test you implemented and how it performed (if applicable)


Fill in this form after the job role, you will get all your information here.

title: Representante Comercial (RCA) | Hunter Região Sul
description:
Sobre a vaga


Mobiis

Modelo de trabalho: Remoto (com atuação externa na região)

Região Sul



Sobre a vaga


Buscamos Representantes Comerciais (RCA) com forte perfil hunter , foco em prospecção ativa, abertura de mercado e fechamento de novos contratos , para expandir a presença da Mobiis em diferentes regiões do Brasil.

Este profissional será um dos principais vetores de crescimento da companhia , levando ao mercado o ecossistema SaaS da Mobiis — soluções que transformam desafios logísticos complexos em eficiência operacional, redução de custos e ganho de escala , com foco em receita recorrente (MRR) e serviços.


Missão da função


Atuar de forma estratégica e autônoma na prospecção e aquisição de novos clientes, construindo um pipeline saudável e previsível, convertendo oportunidades em contratos e fortalecendo a presença da Mobiis no mercado logístico.


Reporte e interfaces


  • Reporta-se a: Gerente de Vendas da Mobiis
  • Interage com: Pré-Vendas, Marketing, Customer Success e time Comercial Interno


Principais responsabilidades


Prospecção ativa e abertura de mercado (Hunter)


  • Prospectar novos clientes de forma ativa (outbound): embarcadores, operadores logísticos, indústrias, distribuidores e varejo.
  • Mapear contas-alvo, decisores e influenciadores na região de atuação.
  • Atuar por múltiplos canais: telefone, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, e-mail e visitas presenciais.
  • Construir, gerir e manter pipeline próprio, contínuo e previsível.


Venda consultiva e condução do ciclo comercial


  • Conduzir reuniões de diagnóstico aprofundado (AS-IS / TO-BE).
  • Identificar dores operacionais, gargalos logísticos e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Apresentar de forma consultiva as soluções do portfólio Mobiis.
  • Elaborar e conduzir propostas comerciais envolvendo MRR, implantação, integrações e serviços.


Negociação e fechamento


  • Conduzir negociações com autonomia, respeitando as políticas comerciais da Mobiis.
  • Atuar com forte foco em fechamento, previsibilidade e geração de nova receita.
  • Garantir transição estruturada do cliente para os times de Implantação e Customer Success após o fechamento.


Gestão comercial e inteligência de mercado


  • Manter organização do funil de vendas e reportes periódicos de pipeline e resultados.
  • Monitorar concorrência, práticas comerciais e tendências do mercado regional.
  • Reportar oportunidades, riscos e insights estratégicos à liderança comercial.
  • Identificar e desenvolver potenciais parcerias regionais.


Metas e indicadores (referência)


  • Novos contratos fechados (MRR e serviços).
  • Volume mensal de oportunidades qualificadas geradas.
  • Taxa de conversão e ticket médio.
  • Ciclo de vendas e previsibilidade do pipeline.
  • Metas definidas em conjunto com o Gerente de Vendas, considerando o potencial da região.


Requisitos obrigatórios


  • Experiência comprovada em vendas B2B outbound (perfil hunter).
  • Histórico consistente em abertura de novos clientes e desenvolvimento de mercado.
  • Vivência em vendas consultivas e negociação com decisores.
  • Perfil empreendedor, autônomo, disciplinado e orientado a resultados.
  • Excelente comunicação, organização e capacidade de autogestão.
  • Carro próprio e disponibilidade para deslocamentos e visitas comerciais.
  • Residência no polo regional de atuação ou proximidades.


Diferenciais (alto peso)


  • Conhecimento em soluções alinhadas ao portfólio da Mobiis, como:
  • TMS (Transportation Management System)
  • WMS (Warehouse Management System)
  • DMS (Delivery Management System)
  • YMS (Yard Management System)
  • Roteirização e otimização logística
  • Plataformas SaaS para logística, transporte e supply chain
  • Relacionamento ativo com embarcadores, operadores logísticos, indústrias ou distribuidores.
  • Experiência em vendas de software SaaS e contratos recorrentes (MRR).
  • Conhecimento de indicadores logísticos (OTIF, custo de frete, produtividade, nível de serviço).


Exclusividade e conflito de interesses


  • Não há exigência de exclusividade.
  • O RCA poderá representar outras empresas, desde que não concorrentes diretas ou indiretas da Mobiis.
  • Eventuais conflitos de interesse serão analisados previamente pela Mobiis.
  • Território de atuação definido para organização comercial e proteção de oportunidades.


Modelo de remuneração


  • Modelo comissionado , com comissões atrativas sobre:
  • Receita recorrente (MRR)
  • Serviços (implantação, integrações, projetos e upsell inicial)
  • Possibilidade de ganhos recorrentes enquanto os clientes permanecerem ativos.
  • Percentuais, regras e condições definidos em contrato de representação comercial.


Suporte da Mobiis


  • Onboarding comercial e técnico sobre portfólio, mercado e posicionamento.
  • Materiais de vendas, apresentações e apoio do time de Pré-Vendas.
  • Acompanhamento próximo do Gerente de Vendas.
  • Marca consolidada, soluções robustas e alto potencial de crescimento.

Key responsibilities include financial statements, budgeting and forecasting, internal controls, cash flow, payroll, and financial systems management. You will also help guide the consulting delivery team by overseeing financial processes used in client work and supporting the development of scalable delivery practices.

If you enjoy building structure, improving systems, and partnering with leadership to drive growth, this Controller role will be a great fit.

  • Oversee Financial Systems: Manage and enhance financial software and reporting systems for efficiency and accuracy.
  • US Payroll Oversight: Manage or review W2 and contractor payroll processes to ensure accuracy, compliance, and timely execution.
  • Lead the Delivery Team: Support and guide the financial consulting delivery team, ensuring consistent processes, high‑quality client work, and scalable operational practices.
  • Shape Operational Practices: Contribute to building and refining the firm’s financial delivery frameworks, systems, and internal processes.
  • Client Financial Services Support: Collaborate with consultants to support client financial operations and ensure strong service delivery across engagements.

About the role

  • We are looking for a Data Engineer with strong experience in modern data platforms to support a large-scale migration initiative to Snowflake.
  • The role focuses on migrating approximately 1,000 datasets while adapting existing pipelines and workflows to a new architecture.
  • You will work with orchestration tools and cloud-based data lakes to ensure reliability, performance, and data quality.
  • The architecture is already defined internally, so the role is execution-focused and highly hands-on.
  • This position requires strong expertise in SQL, Python, and distributed data processing tools.


Responsibilities

  • Execute the migration of approximately 1,000 datasets to Snowflake.
  • Adapt and refactor existing data pipelines to align with the Snowflake architecture.
  • Develop and test pipelines using Python and Apache Airflow.
  • Support workflow orchestration, scheduling, and monitoring in Apache Airflow.
  • Ensure data quality, reliability, and performance across migrated datasets.
  • Work with data stored in AWS S3 data lakes, including partitioning and lifecycle policies.
  • Implement testing strategies for data pipelines.
  • Collaborate with internal teams following the predefined architecture and technical approach.
  • Work with streaming or event-driven data using Apache Kafka.
  • Support distributed processing workloads using Apache Spark.


Must have skills

  • 7+ years of experience in Data Engineering or related roles.
  • 7+ years of experience with Python (7–9 years).
  • Advanced SQL (complex joins, CTEs, window functions, performance tuning).
  • Snowflake (data modeling and pipeline integration).
  • Apache Airflow (pipeline development and orchestration).
  • Apache Spark (distributed data processing).
  • Apache Kafka.
  • AWS experience, especially S3 (data lakes, partitioning, lifecycle policies).
  • Experience in defining and implementing testing strategies for data pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining production-grade data pipelines.


Nice to have skills

  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake migrations (data warehouse modernization, performance optimization, cost optimization).
  • Experience with Apache Airflow migrations (version upgrades, executor changes, or platform migrations).


Conditions

  • Remote role (100% remote). Primary timezone: UTC-6 with at least 8 hours of overlap required.
  • Contractor role (initially 3-month contract, but renewable: expected overall duration up to 12 months).
  • Full-time dedication (40 hours/week).
