title: Senior Content Manager
description:
As a Senior Content Manager, you will play a key role in supporting MoveUp Media’s growth by owning the operational and strategic execution of content across our website portfolio. You will take ownership of content performance and strategy across our websites, while leading day-to-day content operations and working closely with SEO and cross-functional teams. You will be responsible for turning content and SEO strategies into measurable results, while ensuring high-quality standards across multi-language teams and markets.


This role contributes directly to the CORE department’s objectives by supporting the growth, stability, and diversification of the business through content performance, strong processes, and effective collaboration. You will act as the main point of ownership for content quality and delivery, working closely with SEO, Product, and cross-functional teams.


To be more specific, you will:


  • Lead and develop the content strategy for our flagship, multi-language websites across multiple markets
  • Manage content workflows and ensure consistent, high-quality output across all sites
  • Oversee content quality, structure, and standards across our portfolio
  • Work proactively with content teams to define and implement content checklists and best practices
  • Collaborate closely with SEO, Tech, Design, and Product teams to ensure content and SEO best practices are followed
  • Ensure all SEO and content checks are completed ahead of website launches or redesigns
  • Regularly review websites to identify issues, suggest improvements, and support teams with implementation
  • Monitor content performance and report progress and key initiatives to senior stakeholders
  • Ensure content meets compliance and regulatory requirements and oversee necessary updates
  • Stay up to date with market trends, best practices, and iGaming innovations
  • Support hiring and team development (mentoring) in collaboration with Talent Acquisition and HR.


The ideal profile


We’re looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results.


You are someone who:


  • Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role
  • Has iGaming experience (a strong plus, not a must)
  • Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus)
  • Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency
  • Is comfortable reviewing and optimising content rather than writing it


You bring strong CM fundamentals:


  • High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills
  • Ownership mindset over site and content performance
  • Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into clear actions
  • Strategic thinking and the ability to plan toward defined goals
  • Experience working with CMS platforms


You work well with others and think ahead:


  • Collaborative approach, especially when working with SEO teams
  • Proactive in sharing ideas, flagging issues, and suggesting improvements
  • Open to experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement
  • Positive attitude with a growth mindset and leadership potential


Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.


Next steps in the process ✅


  • 1rst Interview with your future manager to make sure you meet the role’s requirements
  • 2nd interview with HR to better understand who you are and make sure there is a cultural fit with MoveUp Media
  • Last step: a proposition for us to start working together!


What’s in it for you


  • A full time remote work environment.
  • A flexible schedule and paid time off. We measure results , not hours.
  • Competitive salary, depending on your level of seniority in the role and your location
  • Development opportunities. As a startup with rapid growth, there are a lot of possibilities that can arise and we are committed to accompany our team members in their career path.
  • Yearly get together with the team to connect, work and have fun . We strive to find good spots for everyone to enjoy the stay!


MoveUp Media

title: Forensic Manager
description:
This leading multinational group, with significant operations across the Americas and worldwide, is seeking an experienced Forensic Manager to lead a team of corporate investigators across their regional operations.


Based in Belo Horizonte, you will be responsible for managing a team of forensic specialists who are overseeing investigations into complex financial crimes, including conflict-of-interest, procurement fraud, misappropriation of assets, corruption, and bribery.


Your role will be primarily focused on team leadership, setting key performance objectives, and building strategic relationships to ensure seamless regional operations. You will have day-to-day responsibility for managing forensic specialists, providing career development guidance, and overseeing resource allocation. Furthermore, you will serve as the primary point of contact for operational management while playing a key role in the overall strategic management of the group’s investigative objectives.


In addition to your leadership duties, you will undertake high-level corporate investigation projects, conduct fraud awareness training, and oversee the integration of data analytics into investigative workflows.


To be successful in this role, you should possess extensive experience in leading complex corporate investigations and managing specialized forensic teams. You are likely currently working in a managerial capacity within a forensic advisory firm or a comparable corporate business.


While a CFE qualification is highly welcomed, we value your proven ability to lead high-performance teams and manage senior stakeholder relationships. Excellent communication skills are essential, and candidates must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. Proficiency in Spanish and experience with advanced data analytics tools are welcomed.

description:

Who We Are: We are a fast growing business and technology consultant company co-founded in 2019. We offer a custom-tailored, white-glove engineering service fit for our clients, because a digital transformation is more than just technology. With a successful track record of being a preferred vendor for Fortune 500 companies and as a trusted partner for some of the industry’s leading companies, our global talent has helped many clients achieve their goals.

“Get Shit Done.”

“Get Over Shit.”

“Give a Shit.”


This role exists to drive value for our customers and business functions through effective data engineering, modelling, and data transformations by leading the delivery of strategic data solutions whilst setting up resilient data architecture and engineering foundations and supporting junior members of the data engineering team.


Responsible for:

  • Leading the design and orchestration of modularized, automated, event-driven data engineering pipelines and data modeling approaches.
  • Building in quality by design into data engineering practices, enabling a scalable and flexible data architecture and feature rich dataset to support the wider Data function and the entire business.
  • Implementing modern code development and data engineering orchestration strategies to target and streamline our data engineering processes.
  • Embedding new data techniques into the business through coaching, training, and providing experiment design oversight to more junior data engineers.
  • Working with third party partners and software providers to improve and/or implement new data solutions and processes.
  • Being the gatekeeper for customer data, aware of our usage and alignment to data privacy standards, in collaboration with Data Governance to ensure best practice standards are applied/maintained.


Accountable for:

  • Working closely with our Lead Data and ML Engineers to drive the adoption of DevOps and modern code development practices across the Data function.
  • Collaborating with Quality and Software Engineering and System teams to drive cross-function visibility and reduction of technical debt across the teams.
  • Ensuring that our data engineering processes and pipelines are resilient and future-proof.
  • Developing a strong knowledge of all data sources and maintaining relationships with data users/processors across the company.
  • Being a Senior Data Engineer, supporting more junior data engineering colleagues from a technical skills development perspective.


Essential skills and experience:

  • Extensive expertise of RDBMS, Python, Hadoop, SQL and Pyspark.
  • GCP experience, including Dataproc and Dataflow
  • Hands on Java experience
  • Hands on experience in modern code development practices (Infrastructure-as-Code) and data engineering in the Google Cloud
  • Experience of ETL/ELT technical design, automated testing of engineering pipelines, quality assurance and documentation.
  • Proven experience of data warehousing, data wrangling and data modelling approaches.
  • Proven experience coaching junior members of data engineering teams and supporting their skills development.
  • Proven experience working collaboratively with System, Quality Engineering and Software Engineering teams.
  • Demonstrable experience of critical thinking, communication and problem-solving ability and stakeholder management
  • Demonstrate delivery under pressure and to deadline.
  • Experience working in an e-commerce/retail market would be beneficial.


Preferred skills and experience:

  • Willingness to learn new tools and techniques; proactively keeping up to date with latest thinking and practices.
  • Able to establish what does/doesn’t align to business/functional strategies/priorities and communicate dependencies clearly.
  • Able to drive the adoption of best practice approaches to data engineering, coaching, and supporting the wider data engineering team.
  • Embrace change with a positive outlook.
  • Confident to challenge, and receptive to being challenged.
  • The ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.



Join Our Global Team: We invite you to apply for the position at RE Partners. Join us in shaping the future of business technology consulting and transforming the way organizations thrive in a digital world. As a diverse, woman-owned global business, we pride ourselves on keeping talent happy – our 7% attrition rate speaks volumes. Bring your talented friends along and earn a referral bonus

title: Especialista de Negócios em Geotecnologias
description:
Descrição da vaga

Buscamos um profissional sênior e estratégico para atuar na identificação e desenvolvimento de novas oportunidades de negócio, com foco em soluções inovadoras para processos críticos dos nossos clientes e na temática ESG. Se você tem paixão por transformar desafios de mercado em propostas de valor baseadas no uso de geotecnologias, inteligência artifical e analytics, e possui experiência comprovada no ciclo de desenvolvimento de negócios, do insight estratégico à execução das vendas, esta é a sua oportunidade de atuar em uma empresa que usa a tecnologia para transformar negócios e a sociedade.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

O profissional que aceitar esse desafio será responsável por:

Identificar novas oportunidades estratégicas de crescimento, desenvolver e refinar propostas de valor claras e diferenciadas para entrada em novos segmentos e expansão na nossa base de clientes.

Estruturar e posicionar soluções que enderecem de forma eficaz as demandas e necessidades complexas dos clientes,

Definir tecnicamente a arquitetura e a estrutura das soluções propostas, garantindo alinhamento com a necessidade de negócio do cliente e a viabilidade técnica.

Atuar como interface estratégica com áreas técnicas (Arquitetura e Soluções) para a validação, refinamento e garantia da entrega das soluções e garantindo p engajamento necessário em negociações complexas de serviços que envolvam customizações e/ou integrações.

Realizar o acompanhamento contínuo de tendências tecnológicas, inovações e movimentos do mercado para antecipar necessidades e adaptar o portfólio de soluções.

Apoiar a execução da estratégia de vendas e a evolução do pipeline de oportunidades, produzindo documentos de visão e propostas que sejam aderentes aos problemas de negócio, orçamentos e prazos dos cliente e gerenciando o ciclo de vida do funil, desde a prospecção até o fechamento.

Realizar, no papel de um especialista em tecnologia, apresentações sobre a plataforma Esri e soluções de seus parceiros para clientes e em eventos para o mercado, reforçando a proposta de valor da Imagem.



Requisitos e Qualificações

Experiência Sólida em funções de Business Development, Pré-Vendas, Consultoria Estratégica ou Arquitetura de Soluções, preferencialmente em um contexto B2B e B2G.

Profundo conhecimento e habilidade comprovada em estruturar propostas de valor, modelos de negócio e ofertas técnicas complexas.

Capacidade analítica e estratégica para identificar tendências, analisar dados de mercado e traduzi-los em planos de ação e oportunidades de negócio tangíveis.

Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e negociação, com capacidade de interagir e influenciar executivos e áreas técnicas.

Sólido conhecimento em geotecnologias, especialmente plataforma Esri, e suas aplicações nos diversos mercados.

Inglês Fluente/Avançado;

Espanhol avançado será considerado um diferencial.

Formação:

Superior completo em áreas de Tecnologia (Tecnologia da Informação, Ciências da Computação, Engenharia), áreas de Negócios (Economia, Administração) ou em Geociências.

Formação complementar (pós-graduação, MBA ou especialização) em áreas como inovação tecnológica, transformação digital, sustentabilidade, mudanças climáticas ou resiliência ambiental será considerada um diferencial.

With offices in Latin and North America and Europe, we are present in the industrial routines of the largest companies on the planet! Innovation is in our blood! All of this is to improve efficiency and increase productivity for companies by simplifying the SAP asset management process.   • Measure and monitor KPIs to draw insights and execute actions

  • Proactively manage at-risk customers and develop success plans, prevent churn and reduce unnecessary escalations.
  • Expand CSPs to include additional outcomes as customer needs evolve
  • Collaborate with Sales and Marketing to develop customer case studies
  • Build and document new CS processes and procedures including playbooks, process outlines, best practices, engagement strategies, etc.

  • Enthusiasm for customer success and excellence, especially within the SaaS space
  • Willingness to learn, collaborative, growth mindset, goal oriented comfortable with ambiguity / changing priorities as part of the start-up culture
  • Proven record of delivering effortless customer experience, and customer-centric internal communications
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams to support joint outcomes through customer lifecycles
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively via oral & written formats: PowerPoint and Excel skills are a must, especially with multiple stakeholders/personas
  • Demonstrated creation of data-driven customer action plan strategies

Required Skills/Abilities

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Excellent time management skills, managing work time responsibly and efficiently
  • Escalation and conflict management skills
  • Ability to be highly collaborative with internal and external teams
  • Independent, critical thinker/problem-resolution skills
  • High accountability to outcomes
  • 5+ years of experience in direct customer engagement roles
  • 3+ years of SAP PM and/or EAM/CMMS experience
  • Strong verbal and written English


Preferred Skills/Abilities

  • 5+ years of account management, customer success, or managed services
  • CRM experience, managing expansion opportunities and customer relationship mapping
  • 3+ years of SAP PM and/or EAM/CMMS experience
  • Microsoft Office/O365 experience

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree (B. A.) in a related field or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Other

title: Desktop Support Engineer L2
description:
Location: São Paulo

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Desktop Support Engineer L1 L2 to join our team in São Paulo. You will be responsible for delivering high-level support for desktop systems, applications, and network-related issues.

Troubleshoot and resolve Level 2 issues related to hardware, software, and operating systems (Windows/Linux/Mac).

Manage software installations, updates, and patches.

Troubleshoot network connectivity issues, including LAN, WAN, VPN, and Wi-Fi.

Coordinate hardware replacements or repairs with vendors.

Guide end-users on system functionalities and best practices.

Create and maintain technical documentation and user manuals.

System Security & Compliance:

Ensure compliance with company policies related to IT and cybersecurity.

Monitor and resolve antivirus, malware, and other security alerts.

Log, prioritize, and resolve tickets within the defined SLA.

Escalate unresolved issues to Level 3 teams or external vendors.

Proficiency in managing Windows, macOS, and Linux systems.

Strong knowledge of Active Directory, Group Policies, and DNS/DHCP.

Hands-on experience with Office 365, Microsoft Teams, and similar applications.

Familiarity with virtualization tools like VMware or Hyper-V.


Network Skills:

Strong understanding of TCP/IP, DHCP, and DNS.

Experience with VPN and network troubleshooting tools.

CompTIA A+, Network+

Microsoft Certified Solutions Associate (MCSA) or equivalent

ITIL Foundation Certification


Soft Skills:

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Contribuições para projetos open source ou participação em comunidades técnicas.

title: Microsoft 365 Tenant to Tenant Migration Engineer
description:
Company Description

FuseIT Global is a Miami-based IT consulting and staffing company, delivering exceptional services to clients across the globe. Specializing in providing distributed global talent, FuseIT Global addresses diverse IT requirements with tailored solutions. The company's commitment to quality and innovation drives its success in collaborating with businesses of all sizes. FuseIT Global's expertise lies in creating impactful technology strategies to boost clients' business outcomes.


Role Description

This is a remote position as a Microsoft 365 Tenant to Tenant Migration Engineer. The role involves planning, executing, and managing Microsoft 365 tenant-to-tenant migrations, ensuring seamless transitions while minimizing downtime. The responsibilities include diagnosing and troubleshooting technical issues, performing data migrations across environments, and collaborating with the team to optimize software and infrastructure configurations for efficient performance.


Qualifications

·      Microsoft Tenant to Tenant migration skills (Exchange/SharePoint administrative understanding at minimum)

·      Understanding of the Microsoft 365 ecosystem (must have)

·      Quest ODM Tool certification (nice to have)

·      10+ years’ experience in enterprise / corporate environments

·      Strong Azure development experience in production environments

·      Deep .NET / C# expertise, with hands-on work modernizing applications to Azure

·      Azure Functions:

·      Designing, building, and supporting Azure Functions

·      Refactoring legacy .NET/middleware into Azure-native or serverless solutions

·      Experience working with U.S.-based teams and strong English communication

·      Comfortable operating in a near-shore delivery model

﻿·      Availability aligned to ET ± 1 hour

title: Engenheiros de Dados
description:
Job Description

A Genesis Consulting tem oportunidade para Engenheiros de Dados experientes com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e entrega de valor através da tecnologia. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades.

Duties and Responsibilities:

• Liderar a implantação de Data Lakes e Lakehouses, atuando tanto no desenho da arquitetura quanto no desenvolvimento hands-on da solução.

• Projetar, desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados eficientes e escaláveis para garantir a fluidez entre sistemas.

• Garantir a integridade, qualidade e governança dos dados em todas as etapas do pipeline.

• Otimizar processos de armazenamento e recuperação de dados, garantindo desempenho e custo eficientes (FINOPS).

• Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com times de negócio e tecnologia para transformar requisitos em soluções robustas de dados.

• Implementar e monitorar processos ETL/ELT e arquiteturas de processamento de dados em tempo real e batch.

• Apoiar a adoção de boas práticas de engenharia de dados dentro do time.

Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

• Experiência comprovada em design e desenvolvimento de pipelines de dados escaláveis (preferencialmente em Oracle Cloud).

• Proficiência em SQL, Python e ferramentas de processamento de dados distribuídos (como Spark).

• Conhecimento avançado em Infrastructure as Code e práticas de CI/CD.

• Experiência com modelagem de dados e arquitetura de Data Lakes e Lakehouses.

• Forte entendimento de práticas de governança e qualidade de dados.

Minimum Education:

  • Ensino superior completo.
  • Inglês fluente

title: Adobe Developer  (AEM) | Specialist
description:
Você fará parte da Compass UOL, uma empresa global que integra o grupo AI/R Comany ! Atuamos na transformação digital de organizações, ajudando-as a inovar e alcançar resultados de impacto.

Desenvolvemos plataformas digitais e soluções que impulsionam negócios, promovendo eficiência, escalabilidade e experiências diferenciadas.

Com foco em atrair e desenvolver os melhores talentos, criamos oportunidades que transformam vidas e reforçam o papel positivo da tecnologia na sociedade


RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Apoiar decisões arquiteturais e garantir aderência às boas práticas recomendadas pela Adobe;
  • Atuar próximo aos times de negócio e tecnologia, assegurando qualidade técnica, performance e estabilidade das entregas;

  • Trabalhar com configuração, otimização e boas práticas de cache utilizando Dispatcher;
  • Dar suporte técnico aos times envolvidos, atuando como referência técnica e orientando boas práticas de desenvolvimento;
  • Contribuir para a evolução contínua da plataforma digital, colaborando com squads multidisciplinares;
  • Integrar soluções do ecossistema Adobe, quando aplicável, incluindo Target, Analytics e Adobe Experience Platform (AEP).



REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Experiência comprovada com Adobe Experience Manager (AEM);
  • Domínio das linguagens e tecnologias Java, HTML e JavaScript;
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de aplicações;
  • Experiência com integrações utilizando APIs REST;
  • Conhecimento em configuração e uso de Dispatcher e estratégias de cache;
  • Conhecimento em Adobe Target (desejável);
  • Conhecimento em Adobe Analytics (desejável);
  • Conhecimento em Adobe Experience Platform – AEP (desejável);
  • Experiência prévia em projetos de grande escala e alta disponibilidade (desejável).

title: [Vendas] Consultoria de vendas Pleno | Produto RH
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA:

Ser referência para entender, demonstrar e validar os requisitos técnicos e comerciais de um determinado produto e/ou serviço TOTVS, a fim de apoiar os canais de distribuição na geração e desenvolvimento de novas oportunidades de negócios.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Ter bom conhecimento de um produto ou serviço TOTVS, de baixa complexidade, para realizar demonstrações e validações de requisitos técnicos;
  • Conhecer a política comercial e tabela de preço do produto ou serviço sob seu domínio para apoiar os canais de distribuição TOTVS em suas negociações;
  • Interagir com clientes e/ou prospects, com alto nível de orientação e supervisão, por meio dos canais de distribuição TOTVS, para esclarecer suas dúvidas e propor soluções relacionadas ao produto sob seu domínio;
  • Preparar ambientes e sistemas, com alto nível de orientação e supervisão, para a realização de demonstrações, eventos e webinars;
  • Demonstrar o produto ou serviço TOTVS sob seu domínio aos clientes e/ou prospects, através do cumprimento do checklist da apresentação, roteiro e processos estabelecidos pela área;
  • Apoiar, com alto nível de orientação e supervisão, na execução dos planos táticos de vendas dos canais de distribuição TOTVS;
  • Elaborar relatórios para ESNs e/ou Arquitetos dos projetos, apresentando os pontos relevantes de dúvidas e questionamentos do cliente através de ata da reunião.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

Formação: Graduação Completa


Conhecimentos:

  • Pacote Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Notes) - nível básico;
  • Pacote Google Workspace (Google Forms, Gmail, Drive, Google Sheets, etc.) - nível básico


INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

Antes de mostrar nossos benefícios, deixa eu já te contar uma coisa: aqui as coisas acontecem em um ritmo acima da média.

A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. O melhor disso é que temos autonomia para colocar esse aprendizado em prática e buscar resultados.

E se errarmos? Voltamos e consertamos rápido, até criarmos aquilo que acreditamos ser parte da transformação de cada cliente.

Isso tudo acelera o nosso crescimento e nos torna a maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, ditando o ritmo do mercado nos mais diversos setores, fazendo tecnologia que transforma.

Dito isso, oferecemos:

● Universidade em Rede TOTVS, uma universidade Corporativa com conteúdos e certificações gratuitos para cada colaborador;

● Programa +Saudáveis, que cuida de cada colaborador com assessoria e ações voltadas para o bem estar em corpo, mente e finanças pessoais;

● Programa +Vantagens, a maior rede de descontos da América Latina, exclusivos para colaboradores;

● Programa + Cuidado, programa de apoio pessoal para colaboradores e familiares, com orientações em diversas especialidades como: psicologia, serviço social, pet consultoria...

● Einstein Conecta, benefício de orientação médica online pelos médicos do Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, totalmente gratuito;

● Vale refeição e / ou alimentação;

● Vale transporte;

● Espaço de lactário;

● Bicicletário;

● Escritório que estimula a criatividade e produtividade com ambientes para lanches, salas de jogos, mesas de bilhar e poltronas para relaxar;

title: Cientista de Dados - Sênior
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?

Então essa é a sua chance!



Buscamos: Cientista de Dados - Sênior



Resumo: Atuar como referência técnica e analítica na estruturação, evolução e confiabilidade dos dados de Ad Intelligence, transformando grandes volumes de dados complexos em insights estratégicos que apoiem decisões de negócio, desenvolvimento de produto e melhoria contínua dos processos operacionais. O cargo combina excelência técnica em Data Science com forte entendimento de mídia, metodologia e negócio, atuando como elo entre Dados, Produto, Operações e áreas comerciais, garantindo que o dado seja consistente, confiável, relevante e acionável para o mercado.



Responsabilidades:

  • Estruturar, desenvolver e evoluir metodologias analíticas e modelos de dados aplicados aos produtos de Ad Intelligence, assegurando consistência, robustez e aderência às necessidades do mercado.
  • Conduzir análises aprofundadas de dados para identificar padrões, tendências, anomalias, riscos metodológicos e oportunidades de melhoria nos produtos, processos e entregas.
  • Desenvolver e testar hipóteses de negócio por meio de abordagens quantitativas, apoiando decisões estratégicas e táticas.
  • Atuar como consultor interno para as áreas de Produto, Operações, Taxonomia, Comercial e Liderança, traduzindo dados complexos em recomendações claras e acionáveis.
  • Automatizar análises, relatórios e fluxos de dados, aumentando eficiência operacional, escalabilidade e confiabilidade das entregas.
  • Monitorar continuamente a qualidade, cobertura e consistência dos dados, identificando e investigando desvios, gaps e comportamentos atípicos.
  • Contribuir para a evolução do conhecimento analítico e metodológico da empresa, por meio de documentação, treinamentos, apresentações e troca ativa com outros times.
  • Participar de interações com clientes e fornecedores quando necessário, explicando metodologias, análises e implicações dos dados de forma clara e transparente.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre tendências em mídia, digital, cross-media, Data Science e Analytics, propondo inovações aplicáveis ao contexto da Kantar.



Conhecimento Essencial:

  • Forte experiência em análise de dados, modelagem estatística e Data Science.
  • Domínio de Python e/ou R e SQL.
  • Inglês avançado.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de visualização (Power BI, Tableau ou similares).
  • Experiência com grandes volumes de dados e pipelines analíticos.
  • Capacidade de traduzir problemas de negócio em problemas analíticos e vice-versa.
  • Comunicação clara, didática e colaborativa.



Conhecimento Desejável:

  • Conhecimento de ambientes de cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP).
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis.
  • Conhecimento específico de mídia digital, cross-media, CTV, VOD.
  • Entendimento de mídia, publicidade e métricas de investimento (ou capacidade de aprender rapidamente).
  • Conhecimento de banco relacional e databricks.




O que oferecemos?

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:



  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação
  • Horário Flexível
  • Modelo de trabalho remoto
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica
  • Convênio Farmácia
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados
  • Previdência Privada
  • Licença Maternidade com duração de 6 meses
  • Licença Paternidade estendida com duração de 20 dias
  • Licença Maternidade/Paternidade para casais homoafetivos
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras
  • Programa de Qualidade de vida: Convênio com academias, ginastica laboral com profissional de educação física toda semana, palestras sobre temas relevantes, vacinação contra a gripe; Programa Global de Assistência ao colaborador e seus familiares (assistência jurídica, psicológica ou financeira) e muito mais
  • Programa de Mobilidade Interna: a Kantar valoriza seus talentos internos e por isso as vagas disponíveis são divulgadas internamente possibilitando ao colaborador mudar de área ou divisão diferente da que atua



Se o seu perfil corresponde aos nossos valores e objetivos, deixe seu currículo conosco e não perca a chance de fazer parte de nossa equipe. Esperamos por você!



Na Kantar IBOPE Media, a diversidade faz parte do negócio, gerando inovação e resultados. Não fazemos distinção de raça, religião, nacionalidade, gênero, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, idade, deficiência, gravidez, estado civil ou qualquer outra forma de discriminação.

title: Engenheiro de dados - Líder Técnico
description:
A VMBears é uma empresa jovem e moderna com o objetivo de ajudar seus clientes a aproveitar novas tecnologias para acelerar seus negócios. Fornece serviços de consultoria para arquitetura corporativa e modernização de sistemas para nuvem. Fundada em 2018, possui em seu DNA a ética, a positividade, o comprometimento e a inovação. Somos focados em oferecer os melhores serviços prestados através dos melhores profissionais do mercado. Esses recursos são utilizados para auxiliar os clientes em sua jornada de modernização tecnológica e transformação digital.


O que buscamos?

O Engenheiro(a) de Dados é o profissional que constrói e mantém a infraestrutura responsável por mover, transformar e disponibilizar dados com confiabilidade e performance. Um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados eficaz domina pipelines batch + streaming, otimiza consultas em data-warehouses colunares e garante a rastreabilidade ponta-a-ponta de cada registro. Na prática, atua como elo entre arquitetura e desenvolvimento, permanecendo intrinsecamente ligado(a) ao código que sustenta o fluxo de informações.


Na VMBears, o Engenheiro(a) de Dados é o(a) guardião(ã) da qualidade dos dados: projeta pipelines escaláveis, monitora sua saúde em produção e antecipa gargalos. Para este projeto, a modernização de um motor de cálculo de alto volume no setor de energia, buscamos alguém que una profundidade técnica em processamento distribuído e lakehouse a uma mentalidade de produto baseada em dados.


Você integrará o squad que modernizará o Motor de Cálculo, um engine que processa bilhões de registros, aplica centenas de fórmulas regulatórias e gera resultados contábeis que movem o mercado de energia elétrica. Procuramos alguém que combine habilidade de modelar dados massivos com espírito de colaboração, ajudando o time a migrar de um monolito PL/SQL para uma plataforma distribuída, event-driven e cloud-native, onde cada byte chegue rápido, íntegro e auditável ao novo motor.


Responsabilidades:

  • Implementar soluções com arquitetura de dados distribuída, garantindo latência e throughput que atendam aos requisitos da do negócio;
  • Implantar pipelines de ingestão, transformação e publicação que suportem batch + streaming em larga escala;
  • Desenvolver jobs Spark/Flink e para data-warehouses colunares;
  • Seguir padrões de versionamento, catalogação e lineage de dados para rastreabilidade de processamento;
  • Desenvolver processos sempre visando o menor custo e maior performance em Redshift/BigQuery/Athena, propondo ajustes de partição, compressão e caching;
  • Documentar processos e fluxos de trabalho de dados: Manter registros detalhados dos processos de dados para facilitar a manutenção e a melhoria contínua;
  • Projetar sistemas que possam crescer conforme a demanda por dados aumenta.


Stack desejável:

  • Redshift, BigQuery, Snowflake, Athena, Iceberg, Delta Lake;
  • Spark (DataFrames, Structured Streaming), Flink, EMR, Dataproc, Databricks, Hadoop (YARN, HDFS);
  • Apache NiFi, Kafka Connect, AWS DMS, Kafka, Kinesis, Pub/Sub;
  • Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, OpenTelemetry, DataHub, Great Expectations;
  • Terraform/IaC, CI/CD Git, testes de dados automatizados, segurança LGPD (IAM fine-grained, encryption at rest/in transit).


Requisitos imprescindíveis:

  • Formação em Ciência da Computação ou área relacionada;
  • Experiência comprovada como Engenheiro de Dados: Ter um histórico sólido na área de engenharia de dados. Pensamento lógico e solução de problemas complexos.
  • Proficiência em alguma linguagem de programação (Python, Java e outras) e SQL: Ser capaz de usar essas linguagens de programação para manipular e gerenciar dados.
  • Conhecimento em tecnologias de big data: Familiaridade com ferramentas que permitem o processamento de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Experiência com sistemas de gerenciamento de banco de dados: Saber como projetar e manter bancos de dados eficientes. Organização para gerenciar grandes volumes de dados e processos críticos.
  • Habilidades de resolução de problemas e pensamento analítico: Capacidade de identificar e resolver problemas complexos de dados. Habilidade de documentação e boas práticas em arquitetura de dados.


Segue abaixo os benefícios oferecidos:

  • Auxílio home-office;
  • Nossa forma de trabalho é totalmente home-office permitindo que você esteja sempre perto de quem mais importa;
  • Descontos em academias através do Total Pass;
  • Desenvolvimento profissional aqui é primordial, por isso oferecemos um programa de capacitação online onde você recebe R$300,00 de crédito semestralmente para adquirir cursos na plataforma Udemy;
  • Quer se certificar em algum skill que se faz necessário para sua atuação profissional? Reembolsamos suas certificações!
  • Gosta de trabalhar aqui? Então indique um amigo ou parente! Nosso programa de indicação de novos Bears oferece R$2.000,00 por pessoa que permaneça conosco por mais de 3 meses.

title: Consultor(a) SAP SR
description:
Somos a SEIDOR, multinacional de tecnologia e inovação, que oferece um portfólio completo de soluções e serviços para promover a competitividade e a transformação das organizações. São mais de 40 anos acreditando na tecnologia , com 85 escritórios e uma equipe de mais de 7.500 profissionais na Europa, América Latina, Estados Unidos, África, Oriente Médio e Ásia.


Somos parceiros platinum da SAP e temos mais de 8.500 clientes . Nosso portfólio completo é voltado para empresas grandes, médias e em crescimento. Na SEIDOR acreditamos que, para enfrentar os novos desafios do mundo digital, devemos ter os melhores aliados, as tecnologias líderes de mercado e, acima de tudo, as melhores pessoas.


Nós acreditamos no valor das pessoas . Buscamos constantemente atrair e reter talentos, investindo no desenvolvimento de nossos colaboradores e oferecendo oportunidades de crescimento profissional. Nosso time é composto por profissionais colaborativos, autônomos e ágeis que juntos formam um ambiente de trabalho desafiador, dinâmico e sem discriminação, respeitando as diferenças que nos tornam mais humanos.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Company Description


EMP is a media and technology company building audience-driven brands across digital media, content, and now SaaS products.

We started as a digital media group with a fan-first mindset and have grown into a company that blends content, distribution, and technology. Today, we are expanding beyond media into software products that support creators, brands, and audiences. That means design work here goes beyond social graphics and videos. It increasingly touches product thinking, UX/UI, and how software is presented to users.

We move fast, test often, and care about clean execution. Collaboration matters, but so does ownership. If you like building things that ship and actually get used, you will fit in well here.


You Are


An experienced graphic designer who can execute high-quality visual work across media and digital products. You are comfortable working in fast-moving environments, collaborating with editors, marketers, and product-minded teammates. You care about clarity, usability, and aesthetics, not just making things look cool.

You are also curious about software and product design, and you are interested in expanding your skill set into UX/UI and SaaS-oriented design work.


Role Description

This is a full-time, remote role for a Graphic Designer.

You will create visual assets across our media brands, including graphics, branding elements, and design systems for social, web, and video. You will also support our growing SaaS initiatives by contributing to UX/UI design, product mockups, and software framing using tools like Figma.

Your work will sit at the intersection of content, marketing, and product. You will help translate ideas into clean visuals, clear user flows, and consistent brand experiences across platforms.

Day-to-day responsibilities include concepting, designing, iterating based on feedback, and collaborating with media, marketing, and product stakeholders.


Responsibilities


  • Design graphics, branding assets, and visual systems for digital media platforms
  • Support video and social content with strong visual design
  • Contribute to UX/UI design for SaaS and internal software products
  • Create wireframes, mockups, and product flows using Figma
  • Maintain brand consistency across media, web, and product surfaces
  • Collaborate with marketing, content, and product teams
  • Iterate quickly and incorporate feedback without friction


Qualifications


  • Strong foundation in graphic design and visual communication
  • Experience with branding, logo design, and typography
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite
  • Working knowledge of Figma and interest in UX/UI or product design
  • Attention to detail and strong design judgment
  • Clear communication skills and ability to work independently in a remote setup
  • Experience in digital media, marketing, or tech is a plus
  • Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or equivalent experience
  • Fluent in English, written and spoken

title: Senior Mainframe Automation Engineer
description:
Descrição da Vaga:

“Estamos buscando um Engenheiro Sênior de Automação de Mainframe experiente para liderar a migração e otimização de soluções de automação em mainframe. Esta função tem como foco a transição do CA OPS/MVS para o IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS e do CA Automation Point para o IBM Systems Automation for Integrated Operations Management (SAIOM) .

O candidato ideal terá um papel crítico para garantir a eficiência operacional, a disponibilidade dos sistemas e processos de automação contínuos em um ambiente z/OS complexo.

Você irá colaborar de perto com a equipe de Automação para implementar soluções de automação baseadas em políticas, reduzir a sobrecarga administrativa e aumentar a capacidade de resposta dos sistemas. Esta posição não impacta o desenvolvimento de aplicações, mas influencia significativamente as estratégias e operações de automação.”


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar projetos de migração de CA OPS/MVS para IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS e de CA Automation Point para IBM SAIOM.
  • Configurar e implementar soluções IBM Systems Automation, incluindo automação baseada em políticas para ambientes z/OS.
  • Desenvolver e manter regras de automação, execs REXX e configurações do System Automation Policy Database (PDB) .
  • Prestar suporte na instalação e configuração de produtos de automação da IBM.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de operações para otimizar processos de inicialização, desligamento e recuperação dos sistemas.
  • Garantir alta disponibilidade e eficiência dos sistemas críticos por meio de estratégias proativas de automação.
  • Documentar processos, configurações e etapas de migração, garantindo comunicação clara com as partes interessadas.
  • Identificar e resolver problemas relacionados à automação em ambientes de produção.


Quais são as habilidades obrigatórias e níveis de proficiência exigidos para esta posição?

  • Experiência em Operações de Mainframe: Mínimo de 5+ anos em ambiente de operações de mainframe, em funções operacionais, de serviços, consultoria ou suporte.
  • IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS: Conhecimento avançado e experiência prática.
  • CA OPS/MVS: Avançado.
  • TSO e ISPF: Proficiência no uso dessas ferramentas para gerenciamento de sistemas.
  • JCL: Fortes habilidades em Job Control Language.
  • Programação REXX: Capacidade de escrever e manter scripts REXX.
  • System Automation Policy Database (PDB): Conhecimento prático obrigatório.
  • Experiência em Migração: Histórico comprovado em projetos de migração de automação em z/OS.
  • NetView for z/OS: Experiência na implementação e utilização deste produto.
  • Scripting REXX: Avançado.


Quais são as habilidades opcionais e níveis de proficiência desejáveis para esta posição?

  • Conhecimento de outros softwares IBM Z, incluindo operação, configuração e automação de sistemas.
  • Familiaridade com processos de inicialização e desligamento do sistema z/OS.
  • Experiência com SMP/E para instalação e manutenção de software.
  • Entendimento de produtos de automação concorrentes no ecossistema de mainframe.
  • Especialização em configurações de sistemas totalmente automatizados em IBM Z.

title: P&C Insurance Claims Expert
description:

As a P&C Insurance Claims Expert, you serve as the vital connection between our company and our

customers. The primary goal of this role is to ensure that our clients reach their desired outcomes

through the successful use and adoption of our software solutions. By cultivating trusted relationships, proactively guiding clients, and offering expert support, you directly contribute to their satisfaction, loyalty, and long-term success. This position also requires an in-depth understanding of SaaS solutions and insurance operations, as well as a collaborative mindset suited for working in a globally distributed, remote-first team environment.

DESCRIPTION OF ACTIVITIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Build and nurture strong, long-term relationships with customers by serving as their trusted

advisor. Regularly check in with key stakeholders to understand their experience and align on

expectations and needs.


  • Proactive Engagement

Maintain regular contact with customers through scheduled calls, emails, and success planning

sessions. Ensure that their goals are defined and met, anticipate challenges, and propose

proactive solutions to maximize satisfaction.


  • Performance Monitoring

Continuously monitor customer usage, health scores, and performance data to assess how the

product is delivering value. Use insights to identify areas of concern or opportunity and

intervene early when needed.

Collect feedback from customer interactions and communicate relevant insights to the product

development team. Help inform future product enhancements by representing the voice of the

customer.


  • Renewals and Upselling

Take ownership of contract renewals, maintaining strong relationships that support ongoing engagement. Identify and pursue upsell opportunities where additional features or services can deliver added value to the customer.

Support new customers during onboarding by guiding them through our processes and helping them become self-sufficient. Provide training and support to ensure they can use our software confidently and effectively.


  • Internal Collaboration

Work closely with the Professional Services & Sales team to ensure a seamless handover from pre-sale to post-sale. Provide background on customer expectations and align on strategy for long-term success. And other duties assigned.

Success in this role depends on both soft skills and the ability to operate effectively in a digital, global

environment.


Must Haves:

Deep subject matter expertise in Insurance is a non-negotiable for this role. The CSM must be able to communicate with clients in their native language (insurance), understand their needs and deliver consultative insights aligned with FRISS’ product value


Language Skills

  • This role requires tri-lingual language skills:

Native-level Portuguese to serve clients in Brazil; fluent in Spanish to serve clients throughout LATAM; and professional working level in English to communicate within FRISS.


Nice to Haves:

  • Customer Focus and Engagement

You are passionate about helping customers succeed, and you consistently strive to understand

their needs and exceed their expectations.


  • Business & Analytical Insights

You understand how your customers operate and how to align our solutions with their business

objectives. You are analytically inclined and can demonstrate FRISS’ value through storytelling

and analytical insights.


  • Technical Proficiency

You are comfortable using CRM systems, customer success platforms, and other relevant SaaS tools to manage your workflow and customer data effectively. · Global Perspective You thrive in an international, remote-first work environment and can communicate and collaborate across geographies and cultures with ease.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION

Mojo Trek, an Inc. 5000 company, delivers an unparalleled recruitment experience, grounded in transparency and integrity. From midsize technology innovators to Fortune 50 powerhouse corporations, we help our clients build technology teams that make a difference, push the change forward, and develop software critical to their success.


The Observability Enabler


The DevOps Engineer at Mojo Trek is a specialized \"Platform Architect\" who operates as a part-time strategic member of the Elite Squad. Rather than being a bottleneck for deployments, you are an Educator and Guardrail-Builder. You empower the \"Golden Three\" by setting up automated CI/CD pipelines, enforcing security/compliance standards, and enabling the deep observability (DORA/DX) that defines Mojo Trek’s success.

  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Design and maintain reproducible environments that adhere to specific platform standards and patterns.

  • Observability Enablement: Own the tooling and instrumentation (logging, tracing, metrics) that allows Developers and POs to understand system health in real-time.
  • Governance & Compliance: Ensure the solution meets all security and regulatory requirements from day one.
  • Technical Education: Upskill the Software Engineers and Testers to manage their own containerization and basic deployment scripts, reducing hand-offs.


Qualifications

  • Platform Expert: Deep mastery of AWS, Azure, or GCP, specifically regarding container orchestration (Kubernetes/ECS) and serverless architectures.
  • Automation-First: Proficiency in Terraform, Pulumi, or similar IaC tools.
  • Security Mindset: Experience with DevSecOps practices, including secret management and vulnerability scanning.
  • Consultative Mentor: The ability to simplify complex infrastructure concepts for the rest of the team and the client stakeholders.


RACI Profile: The Platform Enabler

  • Accountable (A): CI/CD Pipeline Stability, Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) standards, and Security Compliance.
  • Responsible (R): Observability setup, Cloud resource provisioning, and developer environment automation.
  • Consulted (C): Scale/Performance planning (PE) and disaster recovery strategy.
  • Informed (I): Sprint-level feature releases and routine bug fixes.

title: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Engineer (F&O)
description:
Product Overview:

Vuori is re-defining what athletic apparel looks like: built to move and sweat in but designed with a casual aesthetic to transition into everyday life. Our high energy, fast paced office environment is reflected in the clothes we make. We aim to inspire others to take on all aspects of their lives with clarity, enthusiasm, and purpose…. while having a lot of fun along the way. We are proud to be an outlet for the opportunity of personal growth and success.


Job Overview:

As a Microsoft D365 Lead or Sr Software Engineer you will be part of a growing Dynamics team focusing on Finance and Operations. You will be a lead engineer in the business applications engineering organization, developing features and requirements for Vuori using SOLID engineering principles and ensuring proper test coverage. This role will assist other engineers with blockers and provide escalation support to the business. This role will be critical to the success of the Company’s design, testing, and implementation of Microsoft D365 with ongoing business support and future development after implementation in 2023.


Job Responsibilities:

  • Understand Vuori’s overall business mission, vision, and direction to ensure the design, development, and implementation of solutions are aligned and meet business requirements.
  • Cultivate and disseminate knowledge of application-usage best practices.
  • Develop custom D365 application components based on user requirements when appropriate, using .NET, X++, C#
  • Create classes, table, and form extensions, extend data types and base enumerations, add functionality to model elements, and source code as needed to meet business requirements
  • Testing, QA, and debugging of new software
  • Supports the implementation and continuous improvement to D365 F&O and integration by using strong knowledge and experience of D365 F&O application to increase system performance.
  • Issue/Bug code resolutions
  • Review existing and new X++ code based on performance aspects and best practices
  • Environment code promotions and moves
  • Work cooperatively with others on a team to share information, resolve conflicts, and make decisions
  • Ensure that modifications and extensions are well documented
  • Understanding of cloud architecture and administration
  • Demonstrate industry best practices and how they would be delivered in the solution


Primary Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a relevant field
  • 8+ years of Dynamics 365 F&O Software Development lifecycle, including developing features and requirements.
  • Design Patterns in Object-Oriented Programming
  • Experience with implementation, upgrade, migration, and deployment
  • Experience working in Agile delivery methods and with Azure DevOps
  • Experience with CI/CD processes in relation to Dynamics 365
  • Experience working with integration platforms.
  • Credible and professional presence, good written and verbal communication skills, and the desire to work in a team environment across organization functional boundaries.
  • Experience developing solutions involving Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, Power BI, and Azure.
  • Knowledge of current D365F&O, including best practices with X++.
  • SQL experience.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

description:

This is a full-time fully remote working opportunity where you will be working as part of a Scrum team which requires working closely with other software engineers, stakeholders and contributors on the project. Working with respect to the US timezone is a requirement for the position. Attending meetings, being actively involved in the decision making process and collaborating with all of these stakeholders are essential parts of this position.


Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior iOS Engineer to design, build, and ship high-quality mobile applications, with a strong focus on iOS-first development . This role is ideal for someone who has spent years building production iOS apps, thrives in early-stage or fast-moving environments , and enjoys owning features end to end—from architecture decisions to App Store delivery.


You will work closely with product, design, and backend teams to deliver scalable, high-performance mobile experiences while maintaining clean, testable, and well-structured code.


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain advanced iOS applications , with Android considered a plus.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define requirements, design solutions, and ship new features.
  • Own performance, quality, and responsiveness across the mobile app.
  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, crashes, and complex bugs.
  • Write clean, testable, and maintainable code, contributing to automation and CI/CD workflows.
  • Integrate mobile applications with RESTful or GraphQL APIs and third-party libraries.
  • Make informed architectural decisions suitable for scalable MVPs and growing products .
  • Stay current with iOS best practices, platform updates, and modern mobile development trends.
  • Actively participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies , including planning, reviews, and technical discussions.


Minimum Qualifications

  • 8–10 years of professional experience in mobile development, with a strong focus on iOS.
  • Proven track record of shipping at least one high-quality iOS app to the App Store .
  • Deep proficiency in Swift and SwiftUI (or UIKit, depending on project needs).
  • Solid understanding of the full mobile application development lifecycle , from concept to release and iteration.
  • Strong knowledge of mobile UI/UX patterns and Apple platform guidelines.
  • Hands-on experience integrating mobile apps with RESTful or GraphQL APIs .
  • Proficiency with Git , Xcode , and modern dependency managers such as Swift Package Manager .
  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ownership mindset.
  • Advanced written and spoken English for collaboration in a distributed, international team.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with UIKit , Combine , Async/Await , CoreData , or Realm .
  • Experience implementing or customizing video playback features using AVPlayer / AVKit (or equivalent).
  • Familiarity with Android development (Kotlin/Java) is a plus.
  • Experience setting up or working with CI/CD pipelines for mobile applications.
  • Experience using mobile performance and profiling tools (Instruments, Crashlytics, etc.).
  • Background working in early-stage startups or building MVPs from scratch.


Benefits

  • Yearly Office Allowance Budget
  • Macbook Purchase Support
  • Wellbeing Support


If you think that you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

Only CVs that are in English will be accepted.


Flatiron Software Co has a zero tolerance to discrimination policy. In this regard, during the course of the evaluation of your job application and during all your employment relation, if any, all discriminatory factors such as race, sex, sexual orientation, social gender definitions/roles, colour, national or social background, ethnicity, religion, age, disablement, political opinion or any status that is protected under law shall be totally disregarded.

title: Remote Biomedical Informatics SME - 58854
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

We are seeking highly skilled Biomedical Informatics Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to join our team in developing rigorous, high-quality evaluation questions designed to assess and challenge advanced AI models. The primary objective is to create benchmark questions that test the boundaries of AI capabilities across diverse bioinformatics domains.

This role requires deep technical expertise combined with the ability to craft precise, unambiguous questions with well-defined evaluations. The ideal candidate will possess not only strong theoretical knowledge but also practical experience in designing assessment materials that have deterministic, verifiable outcomes.


Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop challenging bioinformatics coding questions that push the limits of AI model capabilities.
  • Create automated, coding-based evaluations with unit tests that objectively verify correctness.
  • Build comprehensive evaluation rubrics with 7–10 distinct criteria for each bioinformatics question.
  • Ensure every question is self-contained, well-defined, and completely unambiguous, including all domain rules and edge cases.
  • Develop problems where there is exactly one correct answer or outcome that can be deterministically validated.
  • Translate theoretical bioinformatics concepts into concrete, measurable outputs.
  • Enforce performance requirements with explicit constraints and tests to prevent inefficient or brute-force solutions.


Required Qualifications:

Educational Background

  • Master's degree of experience in biomedical data processing and interpretation.
  • Ongoing PhD with 3+ years of experience in biomedical data processing and interpretation.
  • PhD (completed) in Biomedical Informatics, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology or a closely related field (preferred).


Technical and other skills

  • Strong proficiency in biomedical data processing, analysis, and interpretation , including working with large‑scale datasets.
  • Experience with bioinformatics tools and pipelines (e.g., NGS workflows, multi‑omics, etc.).
  • Solid programming skills in Python / R
  • Experience working in Linux/Unix , Docker and version control.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills for working in interdisciplinary research teams


Domain Expertise Requirements

Candidates must demonstrate deep, expert-level knowledge in at least TWO (2) of the following five core bioinformatics domains:

1. Biomedical Image Processing

  • Processing of Radiology imaging: CT, MRI, PET/SPECT, Ultrasound imaging
  • Automating cell counting, identifying cell types, and analyzing tissue structures in pathology slides
  • Computational segmentation and boundary inference
  • Medical image formation, reconstruction & enhancement
  • Noise modeling and statistical denoising
  • Image sampling theory and resolution limits
  • Intensity standardization and harmonization
  • Geometric transformations and spatial calibration
  • Multi-modal image registration and alignment
  • Morphological and topological shape analysis
  • Quantitative imaging feature extraction
  • Fusing data from different modalities (MRI, PET, Genomics) for a comprehensive view to tailor treatments
  • pattern recognition and predictive modeling

2. Biomedical Signal Processing

  • Cardiovascular/hemodynamic signals (ECG, PPG, BP, HRV, etc)
  • Neural/brain electrical signals (EEG, EP/ERP; seizure/cognitive analysis)
  • Neuromuscular/motor signals (EMG, motor unit decomposition; prosthetics/rehab)
  • Ocular/visual system signals (EOG, blink/saccade analysis)
  • Respiratory signals (airflow, effort; sleep/disordered breathing)
  • Nonlinear, Statistical, and Adaptive Signal Analysis
  • Multichannel, Spatial, and Connectivity Signal Analysis
  • Machine Learning and Data‑Driven Biomedical Signal Analysis
  • Clinical Monitoring, Wearable, and Translational Signal Processing

3. Molecular & Omics based Personalized Medicine

  • Omics based risk / disease prediction (GWAS, PRS, bulk, single‑cell RNA‑seq, proteins / metabolite signatures associated with diseases)
  • Risk Prediction and Prognosis Modeling
  • Molecular patient subtyping
  • Liquid Biopsy and Circulating Biomarkers (ctDNA, cfRNA/miRNA, MRD, etc.)
  • Causal Inference & Mechanistic Inference (ATE/CATE, Trial emulation and counterfactual modeling)
  • Cross‑modal data fusion (omics + EHR + imaging / signals)
  • Longitudinal Patient Modeling and Disease Progression
  • Patient Stratification and Subtyping (molecular subtypes, endotypes)
  • Electronic Health Records and Clinical Data Science

4. Drug Discovery & Repurposing

  • Treatment response prediction
  • Structure-based drug design (Molecular docking, binding site analysis, Virtual screening workflow)
  • Protein structure analysis (PDB/mmCIF handling)
  • Chemoinformatics ( Ligand-based screening, molecular fingerprinting, 2D/3D data handling and chemical space analysis)
  • QSAR & ADMET Modeling
  • Drug–target interaction prediction
  • Drug sensitivity prediction in disease models
  • Repurposing via omics/network associations
  • Predictive Modeling for Drug Discovery Molecular Dynamics Simulation of Biomolecules (QM, DFT, stability, reactivity, PCA analysis )

5. Software / Utilities

  • Tool installation & environment management (docker/conda/pip)
  • Format conversion/validation (FASTA/FASTQ, BAM/VCF, PDB)
  • GUI-driven analysis workflows (step-by-step runs)
  • Workflow automation (scripts wrapping GUI tools)
  • Visualization tools (genome browsers, 3D viewers)
  • Container/VM execution and troubleshooting
  • Batch processing and report generation
  • Pipeline interoperability checks
  • Reproducibility packaging (configs, manifests)
  • Debugging typical bioinformatics tool errors

6. Regulatory Science and Clinical Policies

  • FDA/EMA regulatory pathways
  • Clinical Practice Guidelines & Standards of Care (e.g., NCCN, AHA, etc.)
  • Diagnostic Biomarker & Therapeutic Use Constraints
  • Medical Scenario Reasoning (case vignettes, Differential diagnosis)
  • Data & Content Compliance
  • Ethical Use, Safety, and Harm Prevention
  • Model Use Governance & Auditability
  • Policy‑Aligned Language & Communication
  • Clinical validation and cohort generalization
  • Privacy‑preserving learning


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : At least 30 hours per week. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 2 months; (expected start date is next week)


Evaluation Process:

  • Take home Assessment on Biomedical Informatics (2-6 hours)
  • Delivery discussion(15-30mins)


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

Buscamos uma pessoa Cientista de Dados para atuar na frente de Alocação/Abastecimento em varejo, com foco em decisão de estoque orientada por dados (reduzir ruptura/excesso e aumentar venda/margem com nível de serviço).

  • Liderar (ponta a ponta) iniciativas de Ciência de Dados para alocação/abastecimento no varejo, do problema ao impacto em produção.
  • Desenvolver, validar e evoluir em todo ciclo de vida (exploração → deploy → monitoramento) modelos e análises (forecast, propensão, anomalias, clusterização, otimização) para decisões de estoque e demanda.
  • Definir e acompanhar métricas de sucesso (modelo + negócio) e garantir monitoramento, logs/observabilidade.
  • Traduzir achados em recomendação acionável e atuar em squad/quarteto multidisciplinar (produto, engenharia, negócio, dados e design).

  • Mentorar cientistas mais júnior com rigor técnico (revisão de abordagem, boas práticas e desenvolvimento).
  • Manter a documentação dos sistemas/modelos/dados atualizada e relevante, garantindo rastreabilidade e seguindo boas práticas de versionamento, code review e reprodutibilidade.


Requisitos Necessários

  • Experiência sólida em Ciência de Dados aplicada com entregas em produção e impacto mensurável.
  • Domínio de Python e SQL (modelagem, feature engineering, pipelines analíticos), com prática de Git/versionamento e revisão de código (code review) em fluxo colaborativo.
  • Base forte em estatística aplicada (validação, métricas, vieses, experimentação quando aplicável).
  • Capacidade de transformar problema de negócio em solução técnica (trade-offs claros, foco em valor).
  • Boa comunicação e autonomia para atuar como referência técnica em iniciativas multiárea com público técnico e não técnico.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em varejo / estoque / alocação / omnichannel .
  • Domínio prático de IA/ML aplicado (da modelagem à operação): forecast , propensão , anomalias , clusterização/segmentação , otimização , recomendação e noções de MLOps/observabilidade, pipelines e ambientes cloud (GCP) .
  • Experiência com GenAI/LLMs para explicabilidade/assistentes (ex.: RAG, agentes, geração de explicações e recomendações com guardrails).
  • Ter construído soluções de decisão e explicação , como:


  • Explicar políticas e movimentações de estoque (por que decidiu X) com feature importance/SHAP e narrativas.
  • Monitoramento + alertas (drift, performance, ruptura/excesso recorrente, mudança de padrão produto×loja, lead time real).
  • Uso de variáveis externas (clima, eventos, datas comerciais, economia) como features/contexto.
  • Segmentação inteligente e priorização produto×loja com base em comportamento real.

Enjoy the flexibility of working from anywhere in Brazil, with collaborative tools and a supportive team environment tailored for beginners eager to grow their skills.

title: Senior Data Pipeline Engineer
description:
Senior Data Pipeline Engineer


Location: Brazil (Remote)


About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations.


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is hiring a Senior Data Pipeline Engineer to own and scale the data infrastructure that powers our platform, building integrations, transformations, and orchestration that ensure reliable, analytics-ready data for hundreds of customer workspaces.


Position Overview:


For our Client we're hiring a Senior Data Pipeline Engineer to own and scale the data infrastructure powering our platform. You'll build integrations from marketing and sales platforms, transform raw data into analytics-ready models, and orchestrate pipelines that run reliably across hundreds of customer workspaces. This foundational role requires architectural thinking, experience with ELT patterns, columnar storage, and multi-tenant systems. If you love designing clean data models, building robust pipelines, and connecting new data sources end-to-end, this is the role for you.


What You'll Do

  • Expand our data integrations — add new source connectors (ad platforms, social media, payment processors) with full extraction, loading, transformation, and orchestration flows
  • Write and maintain incremental SQL transformation models across staging, core, and analytics layers optimized for a columnar analytics engine
  • Design and maintain orchestration workflows — event-driven sensors, schedules, partitions, and automated pipeline chains
  • Optimize our analytics warehouse — schema design, partitioning strategies, materialized views, sort keys, and data retention policies for performance at scale
  • Scale our multi-tenant architecture — each customer workspace gets isolated databases, and you'll manage the per-tenant pipeline lifecycle
  • Build data quality checks, freshness monitoring, alerting, and pipeline health dashboards


What You Bring

  • 5+ years of progressive experience in data engineering — we care about your growth trajectory, not just time served
  • Strong SQL skills — CTEs, window functions, complex aggregations, and performance tuning for analytical workloads
  • Production experience with columnar analytics databases (ClickHouse, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or similar OLAP engines)
  • Hands-on experience with ELT pipelines and SQL transformation frameworks (dbt or similar)
  • Experience with modern data orchestration tools (Dagster, Airflow, Prefect, or similar)
  • Comfortable writing data pipeline code in Python
  • Experience with cloud-based data integration platforms for managing source connectors and sync configurations
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience


Nice to Have

  • Experience with marketing and ads platform APIs (TikTok, Meta, Google Ads, Pinterest)
  • Background in multi-tenant data architecture — per-customer database isolation and credential management
  • E-commerce domain knowledge — orders, customers, transactions, RFM segmentation, customer lifetime value
  • Experience with PostgreSQL and cross-database patterns between relational and analytical databases
  • Familiarity with Next.js or TypeScript — our console is built with Next.js, and wiring integrations into the frontend is a plus
  • Understanding of how data models feed into AI/LLM agent systems


Who You Are

  • You have a genuine drive to learn and grow — we hire for potential and curiosity as much as current skill
  • You think in systems — you see how extraction, transformation, orchestration, and the analytics layer fit together as one whole
  • You take ownership end-to-end — from designing the schema to monitoring the pipeline in production
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and can make sound architectural decisions without a playbook for every situation
  • You communicate clearly and enjoy working directly with founders and cross-functional teammates


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

We specialize in disciplined capital allocation, stablecoin liquidity management, and cross-border digital payment systems designed for high-performance environments.


Our team combines expertise in crypto markets, treasury operations, gaming finance, and risk management to build secure, scalable payment frameworks. As we expand our poker and gaming payment infrastructure, we are seeking a highly skilled Stablecoin Payments Manager to lead and optimize stablecoin-based settlement and liquidity operations.

title: Finance Business Partner | Accounts Receivable
description:
About Pinnacle Group

Pinnacle Group is a leading workforce solutions and technology services provider delivering innovative, results-driven solutions to global enterprises. With deep expertise in financial operations, staffing models, and program management, we help organizations optimize performance while maintaining strong compliance and operational excellence. Our finance team plays a critical role in supporting scalable growth, operational efficiency, and exceptional client experiences across diverse programs.


Summary

The Finance Business Partner will lead Pinnacle Group’s Accounts Receivable operations while serving as a strategic advisor to client-facing business teams. This role is approximately 70% operational, overseeing billing, collections, reconciliations, supplier payments, and team performance, and 30% focused on financial partnership and business support. The ideal candidate will bring strong leadership, analytical expertise, and a client-service mindset to improve AR performance and drive financial excellence. This position is instrumental in ensuring accurate cash flow management, client satisfaction, and continuous process improvement.


Job Description


Accounts Receivable Management

  • Oversee the full AR lifecycle including invoicing, collections, reconciliations, dispute resolution, and aging analysis.
  • Ensure accurate and timely billing while resolving client exceptions efficiently.
  • Monitor client payments, oversee cash application, and ensure timely settlement reconciliation to support 100% on-time supplier payment SLAs.
  • Partner with Accounts Payable and Treasury to align receivables with cash flow forecasts and payment schedules.
  • Monitor receivables aging and collaborate with client stakeholders and PMO teams to resolve payment inquiries.
  • Manage quarterly client and supplier volume rebates with precision and compliance.
  • Standardize AR policies, procedures, and playbooks across programs while maintaining audit readiness and strong internal controls.
  • Drive automation and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance AR efficiency and scalability.


Finance Business Partnering

  • Serve as the primary finance liaison to program leaders and account managers, supporting invoice-related issue resolution.
  • Provide actionable insights on billing behaviors, dispute trends, and invoicing challenges to improve program performance.
  • Present tailored AR reporting to leadership, highlighting risks, opportunities, and business impact.
  • Support onboarding of new client programs with structured billing guidance and financial playbooks.
  • Collaborate with Legal and Contracts to align billing terms and resolve disputes effectively.
  • Handle sensitive financial matters with discretion, urgency, and professionalism.


Team Management & Development

  • Lead and mentor a team of 2–4 AR analysts across onshore and offshore locations.
  • Manage hiring, training, workload distribution, and performance management in coordination with leadership.
  • Track and analyze AR KPIs including on-time billing, payment application, supplier payment SLAs, and resolution timelines.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, and proactive problem-solving.
  • Design and implement development plans to enhance team autonomy and operational excellence.


Technology & Systems

  • Manage AR modules within Workday and collaborate on system enhancements and integrations.
  • Review testing outcomes for system updates and approve AR-related production releases.
  • Contribute to the AR technology roadmap to support automation and process optimization initiatives.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of management experience in Accounts Receivable or related financial operations.
  • Strong knowledge of US GAAP and accounting principles.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel including pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, and data analysis.
  • Experience with Workday or other ERP/accounting systems.
  • Experience in the staffing industry or Pay-When-Paid programs preferred.
  • Proven leadership experience managing diverse teams and driving measurable performance improvements.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate financial data into business insights.


Why Join Pinnacle Group?

At Pinnacle Group, you will play a strategic role in shaping financial operations that directly impact business growth and client success. We foster a collaborative, high-performance culture where innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement are valued. This role offers significant visibility across business leadership, opportunities to influence process transformation, and the ability to build and develop a strong finance team. If you are driven by operational excellence and strategic impact, Pinnacle Group offers a platform to grow your leadership career.
