title: Conversational AI Engineer
description:
The Conversational AI Engineer is the primary agent builder, responsible for developing and deploying intelligent conversational agents using Google Dialogflow CX. This role owns the conversation layer—from NLU model training and dialog flow implementation through webhook fulfillment and multi-channel deployment. Works shoulder-to-shoulder with the Architect on complex features and consumes RAG/LLM components built by the AI/ML Engineer. Performs preliminary technical testing on all personal deliverables before handoff to the BA for functional validation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement conversational flows, intents, entities, and page/route structures in Dialogflow CX based on user stories and conversation design specifications.
  • Develop webhook fulfillment services in Python or Node.js to handle business logic, API calls, and dynamic responses.
  • Conduct NLU training, testing, and optimization to improve intent recognition accuracy and entity extraction.
  • Integrate generative AI components (built by the AI/ML Engineer) into agent flows—including LLM-powered responses, knowledge retrieval, and summarization features.
  • Deploy and configure agents across channels: web chat, telephony (CCAI), Google Chat, WhatsApp, and custom applications.
  • Design and implement webhook contracts and data schemas between Dialogflow CX agents and n8n workflows (built by the Automation Engineer).
  • Build and maintain n8n workflows for agent fulfillment when scope is straightforward, escalating complex automation to the Automation & Integration Engineer.
  • Implement error handling, fallback strategies, escalation logic, and graceful degradation in agent flows.
  • Perform preliminary technical testing (conversation path testing, webhook validation, intent accuracy checks, regression tests) on all personal deliverables before handoff to the BA.
  • Pair-program with the Architect on complex integrations and participate in code reviews.
  • Manage Dialogflow CX versioning, environment promotion, and agent deployment pipelines.
  • Participate in sprint planning and provide technical estimates for user stories.

Required Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience building conversational AI solutions, chatbots, or voice agents.
  • Strong proficiency with Google Dialogflow CX (flows, pages, routes, webhooks, test cases).
  • Advanced development skills in Python and/or Node.js with experience building and consuming REST APIs.
  • Understanding of NLU concepts: intent classification, entity extraction, context management, slot filling.
  • Familiarity with Google Cloud services: Cloud Functions, Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, Firestore, BigQuery.
  • Experience integrating with enterprise APIs and SaaS platforms (Salesforce, HubSpot, Jira, Slack).
  • Hands-on experience with n8n (preferred) or comparable automation platforms (Make, Zapier) for building workflows.
  • Proficiency with version control (Git), CI/CD, and agile development practices.
  • Disciplined approach to testing: comfortable writing unit tests, integration tests, and conversation test cases.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Vertex AI Agent Builder or Vertex AI Search and Conversation.
  • Familiarity with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar LLM orchestration frameworks.
  • Experience deploying agents in multilingual environments.
  • Knowledge of speech-to-text and text-to-speech services (Google Cloud Speech APIs).
  • Experience with telephony and contact center integrations.

title: ENGENHEIRO DE DADOS SÊNIOR ( COM ATUAÇAO EM PROJETOS DE IA)
description:
Atuar na equipe como Engenheiro de Dados, ou seja, responsável pela criação do pipeline que transforma os dados

brutos que estão nos mais variados formatos, desde bancos de dados transacionais até arquivos de texto, em um

formato que permita ao Cientista de Dados começar seu trabalho. O engenheiro de dados deve manter este pipeline

em execução para que os dados possam ser coletados no momento certo, com o nível de segurança exigido pela

empresa. Ter um histórico sólido como engenheiro de dados, mínimo de 4 anos na função.


O que esperamos?

de dados funcionem de maneira otimizada.

title: Senior Technical Project Manager

description:

  • Práticas FinOps (governança e otimização de custos em cloud).
  • Experiência adicional com service mesh (Istio/Linkerd) e/ou gateways (APIM, API Gateway, Kong).
  • Práticas DevSecOps: scanning de vulnerabilidades (Trivy, Snyk), secrets rotation, políticas de compliance e hardening de pipelines.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:

With a successful track record of being a preferred vendor for Fortune 500 companies and as a trusted partner for some of the industry’s leading companies, our global talent has helped many clients achieve their goals.

“Get Shit Done.”

“Get Over Shit.”

“Give a Shit.”


This role exists to drive value for our customers and business functions through effective data engineering, modelling, and data transformations by leading the delivery of strategic data solutions whilst setting up resilient data architecture and engineering foundations and supporting junior members of the data engineering team.


Responsible for:

  • Developing a strong knowledge of all data sources and maintaining relationships with data users/processors across the company.

Preferred skills and experience:

  • Able to drive the adoption of best practice approaches to data engineering, coaching, and supporting the wider data engineering team.
  • Embrace change with a positive outlook.

  • The ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

title: Ruby on Rails Engineer
description:
About StayFi

StayFi combines IoT and marketing technology for the vacation rental industry (think Airbnb hosts). With our product, vacation rental managers can create a meshable WiFi guest network with a custom-branded WiFi login page that collects guest information. Our software lets them monitor their network remotely and integrates with their marketing tools to help them build relationships with their guests and grow their business.


Over the past 5 years, we’ve built our business from the ground up without the help of large investors. This means we’re growing a sustainable business and we run it independently. We’re a small team so each team member has a big impact on our product and business. And we’re creating tools that our customers truly love.


About You

  • You’re a full stack Ruby on Rails developer with 3+ years of experience.
  • You’re a product-minded engineer with a pragmatic approach to building software.
  • You write expressive readable and maintainable code instead of just hacking together something that only works.
  • You’re curious about IoT, WiFi and building sophisticated 3rd party API integrations.
  • You want to learn how a business operates and get exposure beyond just writing code.


About the Role

  • Write full stack code using Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, Javascript and deploy it via Heroku.
  • Work with the CTO to break down large projects into small shippable slices and execute on those projects.
  • Build API integrations with 3rd party software providers
  • Create intelligent scripts and integrations to automate WiFi management tasks
  • Create and review pull requests in Github.


Why Work at StayFi?

  • You’ll be working directly with the CTO and CEO on mission critical projects.
  • You’ll get mentorship directly from the CTO and senior engineers who can help you go from being a junior or mid-level engineer to being a true master.
  • As you continue to do good work and help our business grow, you can expect increases in your salary or hourly rate.
  • You’ll have the opportunity to learn the ins and outs of running a sustainable and growing business.
  • You’ll be working on a small team, so you’ll get the chance to have a large impact within our company and in the vacation rental industry at large.


Location

  • Join our fully remote team from anywhere in the world. We hire globally and currently have a strong presence in the US, Latin America (Argentina, Brazil, Colombia), Europe (Netherlands, Portugal, Romania), and Africa (Egypt, Nigeria). We are looking for the best talent, regardless of geography.

title: Senior API Engineer (NodeJS, TS, SDUI)
description:
About the Company:

Headspace Health is the world’s most accessible and comprehensive digital mental health and wellbeing platform. Headspace Health will democratize mental health and wellbeing so people around the world are supported by a full spectrum of affordable care. In addition to its vast library of mindfulness and meditation content, our behavioral health system offers emotional support, guidance, therapy, and medication from professional coaches, licensed therapists, and psychiatrists, respectively.

Our mission is to create a world where mental health is never an obstacle. By harnessing the power and convenience of a smartphone, Headspace Health is able to provide access to high-quality care to anyone, anywhere, in order to reduce symptoms of stress, anxiety, and depression.


Role summary:

Lead the design and operation of APIs that power Server-Driven UI for Flutter clients while owning backend services across the stack. You’ll design stable UI contracts and compose client payloads, be comfortable diving into other backend codebases to implement features and fix production issues, participate in the on-call rotation to keep services healthy and low-latency, and drive team capability for SDUI.


Key responsibilities:

  • Design and implement robust RESTful APIs for SDUI, auth, and rate limiting.
  • Implement composition/templating logic that returns client-ready UI payloads with capability-aware fallbacks.
  • Champion SDUI capability across the team: coach engineers, run hands-on workshops, create onboarding/docs, and promote SDUI best practices.
  • Work across multiple backend repositories: add features, refactor, and maintain code quality.
  • Operate production services: own SLAs, alerting, runbooks, incident response, and participate in on-call rotation.
  • Improve reliability and performance (caching, CDN strategies, Redis, profiling, autoscaling, and load testing).
  • Build and maintain CI/CD, testing, and observability (metrics, tracing, logs, dashboards).
  • Integrate personalization, experimentation hooks, and feature flags into the delivery flow.
  • Collaborate closely with mobile/web teams to define contracts and client compatibility.
  • Mentor peers, lead design reviews, and drive API and schema governance and backward-compatibility practices.


Required skills & experience:

  • 7+ years building production microservices and APIs.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with active participation in team ceremonies and the ability to work effectively across engineering, product, and design.
  • Strong Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) experience, including effective use of abstraction and dependency injection patterns to build modular, testable, and maintainable backend systems.
  • Hands-on development in TypeScript for backend services.
  • Proven RESTful API design and contract experience.
  • Solid experience with databases and caching technologies, such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, and Redis, with an understanding of data modeling, query performance, and cache strategies.
  • Strong with AWS (API Gateway/Lambda or ECS/EC2, S3, CloudFront, RDS/ElastiCache or equivalents).
  • Experience with containerization using Docker (image build, Docker Compose, registries, running services in containers).
  • Strong testing experience, including automated testing and manual verification.
  • Experience with production support: alerting, runbooks, incident management, and on-call duties.
  • Familiar with CI/CD, automated testing, and observability tooling (Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, etc.).
  • Good spoken English


Nice to have:

  • Terraform or other IaC for managing AWS resources.
  • Experience instrumenting endpoints and surfacing behavior in analytics platforms such as Amplitude (event schemas, dashboards, alerts).
  • Experience using Statsig, Grafana, and Sentry for experimentation, dashboards, error tracking, and incident diagnostics.
  • Protobuf experience (service/event schema management via service-protos).
  • Background in personalization/experimentation systems.
  • Hands-on development in Python for backend services.


Hiring signals:

  • Examples of evolving APIs without breaking clients and measurable reliability/performance improvements.
  • Proven track record of mentoring and up-skilling engineers—especially enabling teams to adopt and own SDUI patterns.
  • Evidence of effective on-call ownership: resolved incidents, improved runbooks/alerts, postmortems.
  • Code that shows strong testing, observability, and cross-repo contributions.


Perks:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Health/Sport budget
  • Remote work
  • Flexible PTO
  • Global offices
  • Fun, positive, collaborative environment!



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: System Architect (Design System)
description:
Client Summary – Client Corporation

Client Corporation is a global power management leader with a commitment to innovation, reliability, and sustainability. With operations in more than 175 countries, Client designs technologies that improve efficiency, safety, and performance across industrial, electrical, hydraulic, and mechanical systems. As Client expands its digital ecosystem, the company is investing heavily in enterprise architecture, design systems, cloud modernization, and scalable platforms. This role sits at the core of Client’s digital experience strategy and helps shape the future of UI frameworks, enterprise applications, and design consistency across global teams.


Job Description – System Architect (Design System)

Client: Client Corporation

Position: System Architect – Design System

Location: Remote / Hybrid (per Client requirements)


Position Overview

Client’s IT organization is seeking an experienced System Architect – Design System to lead the architecture, design, and end‑to‑end implementation of enterprise‑scale design system solutions. This architect will translate business needs into scalable technical architectures, enforce enterprise standards, and guide development teams through solution execution. As a senior technical leader, this role drives architectural governance, evaluates emerging technologies, and mentors cross‑functional engineering teams.


Key Responsibilities

Architecture & Solution Design

  • Architect and validate enterprise‑grade software and design system solutions.
  • Create architecture artifacts, diagrams, reference models, and technical specifications.
  • Ensure solutions meet performance, availability, and security standards.

Technical Leadership

  • Lead engineering teams through complex technical challenges and solution delivery.
  • Provide mentorship, guidance, and architectural oversight to developers and technical leads.
  • Conduct design reviews, code reviews, and integration planning.

Requirements Translation

  • Translate business and UX requirements into well‑defined technical designs.
  • Define system interactions, data flows, integration points, and component‑level architecture.

Governance & Standards

  • Enforce adherence to Client’s enterprise architecture standards and development guidelines.
  • Participate in architecture governance forums and lead solution approval processes.

Future‑State & Scalability Planning

  • Develop future‑state architecture strategies that ensure scalability, performance, and compliance.
  • Recommend improvements that reduce technical debt and increase architectural maturity.

Implementation Oversight

  • Oversee development lifecycle activities to ensure high‑quality, consistent implementation.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues across front‑end, back‑end, and integration layers.

Strategic Contribution

  • Influence and contribute to Client’s technology roadmap and long‑term digital strategy.
  • Drive innovation and promote adoption of modern frameworks, tools, and best practices.


Required Qualifications

  • 15+ years of experience in software engineering, architecture, and solution design.
  • Extensive experience with Adobe Experience Manager (AEM 6.5) including component development and system integration.
  • 6–7 years of front‑end experience with Angular (19+ preferred), NgRx, and modern UI frameworks (Tailwind, Angular Material, PrimeNG).
  • 10+ years of back‑end experience with Java, .NET, Spring Boot, REST services, and database technologies.
  • Strong understanding of software design patterns, microservices, cloud platforms (AWS or Azure), and security frameworks.
  • Hands‑on experience with DevOps tools including Git, Maven, NPM, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing frameworks (JUnit, Jest, etc.).
  • Excellent communication, system documentation, architecture presentation, and leadership skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience aligning solutions with enterprise roadmaps and long‑term architecture strategies.
  • Background in architectural maturity assessment and technical debt remediation.
  • Demonstrated success in team mentorship, innovation leadership, and technology evangelism.


Why This Role Matters

This architect will define and evolve the technical foundation behind Client’s enterprise design system—ensuring consistency, reusability, and engineering excellence across global applications. The role carries high visibility and has direct influence on Client’s digital modernization initiatives, making it a key strategic position within IT.

title: Product Owner SR

  • Fornecer status sobre o progresso dos objetivos de negócios sob responsabilidade da equipe ágil;
  • Liderar esforços para identificação e resolução definitiva de problemas de produção;

  • Vivência de TI em projetos de desenvolvimento de soluções complexas e de alta disponibilidade;
  • Experiência com diferentes modelos, métricas e cerimônias no nível de equipe ágil.

  • Bachelor’s Degree

Required Certifications:

  • Possuir certificação CSPO ou PSPO

  • English

title: Senior Fullstack Developer (Python + React)
description:
About The Company

Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


About The Opportunity

We're seeking an experienced Senior Full Stack Developer to join our Supply Chain & Operations technology team. This is a high-impact role focused on rapid application development for business-critical systems that power clients' global supply chain, logistics, and operational excellence.

You'll work embedded within a dynamic, hybrid team of internal engineers and external collaborators, collaborating closely with business stakeholders, UX designers, and technical leads to deliver full-stack solutions that solve real operational challenges. This role requires someone who goes beyond just writing code; you'll need to understand user needs, contribute to requirements analysis, and bring strong product thinking to ensure we're building the right solutions.


Responsibilities

title: DevOps Engineer SR
description:
DevOps Engineer SR


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


This is a highly sensitive and mission‑critical role with admin‑level access to the core platform. The ideal professional is exceptionally reliable, security‑minded, technically strong, and trustworthy, ensuring the stability, performance, and resilience of cloud infrastructure supporting large‑scale production systems.

You will lead cloud operations, infrastructure automation, observability, and performance optimization across AWS environments, ensuring secure, cost‑efficient, and scalable solutions.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Manage and optimize AWS infrastructure including ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;
  • Design, deploy, and maintain Infrastructure as Code using AWS CloudFormation;
  • Own and enhance CI/CD pipelines using CircleCI or similar tools, including automated deployments, rollback strategies, and environment versioning;
  • Implement and maintain observability frameworks leveraging tools such as New Relic and Splunk for monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident response;
  • Diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks across databases, services, network layers, and workloads;
  • Lead AWS cost‑optimization initiatives, ensuring performance and reliability remain uncompromised;
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional engineering, architecture, and operations teams to support deployments, troubleshoot issues, and evolve platform capabilities;
  • Ensure best‑in‑class security practices for sensitive production environments, including IAM hardening and compliance with internal controls.


Essential Skills


  • Expertise with ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;
  • Strong experience with CloudFormation for managing AWS infrastructure;
  • Hands-on experience with CircleCI or similar tools, including deployment automation and rollback strategies;
  • Proficiency with monitoring and logging tools like New Relic, and Splunk;
  • Ability to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks in database queries, configurations, and infrastructure;
  • Experience reducing AWS costs while maintaining or improving system reliability and performans.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Hands-on experience operating Amazon Aurora MySQL/Postgres in production environments, including version upgrade procedures, performance tuning, and troubleshooting;
  • Strong understanding of Aurora architecture, read replicas, automated backups, point-in-time recovery, failover mechanisms, and high availability patterns;
  • Proven track record performing database version upgrades in production with minimal downtime, including compatibility testing, replication management, and performance validation.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Product Owner – Jornadas, Serviços & IA (Omnichannel)
description:
Sobre a vaga


Nós da Neppo , empresa do Grupo Sankhya , temos uma grande oportunidade para você, que quer atuar como Product Owner , para atuar em jornadas, serviços & IA com foco em Omnichannel. Buscamos alguém que vá além do operacional e tenha apetite para protagonizar a construção e evolução de jornadas de atendimento, vendas e suporte, combinando IA, automação e processos tradicionais. Aqui, você terá alta exposição, contato direto com os clientes e espaço real para influenciar decisões estratégicas, impactando diretamente a experiência dos clientes e os resultados do negócio.


Atuando desde 2009 em Uberlândia (MG) , na Neppo somos antenados, ligados em tecnologia e em relacionamentos próximos e duradouros entre pessoas e empresas. Vivemos e respiramos criatividade e colaboração, por isso estamos sempre abertos a novos modelos de negócios e parcerias. Trabalhamos sob as premissas de liberdade, criatividade, transparência, comprometimento e inovação tecnológica.


Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho leve, em que nosso time tenha autonomia e flexibilidade. Nossos Neppers e parceiros são o que temos de mais valioso, por isso, estamos sempre pensando em como tornar a Neppo um lugar melhor para nosso time. Buscamos pessoas com iniciativa, sede de conhecimento, dedicação e vontade de crescer!


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Ser responsável pela demanda do cliente, com autonomia para influenciar decisões estratégicas e evoluções da jornada do cliente(Chatbot e agentes de IA).
  • Desenhar, evoluir e escalar jornadas de atendimento e vendas , utilizando IA, automação e fluxos low code.
  • Traduzir problemas reais de negócio e operação em comunicações inteligentes que gerem valor para usuários e impacto para a empresa.
  • Atuar de forma prática na construção de fluxos e jornadas utilizando a ferramenta low code da Neppo.
  • Conduzir projetos mais complexos que envolvam integrações com sistemas internos e externos, utilizando componentes de integração e chamadas a APIs.
  • Conectar contexto de mercado, experiência do usuário e viabilidade técnica nas discussões das jornadas de agentes.
  • Avaliar impactos das decisões do cliente no negócio, priorizando iniciativas com maior potencial de resultado e aplicando as melhores práticas de CX.
  • Atuar além da execução, provocando evoluções contínuas na forma de pensar, construir e entregar as jornadas dentro da área de Serviços.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência prévia como Product Owner ou papel similar, atuando sobre produto, soluções ou projetos saas.
  • Conhecimento sólido em APIs REST, com capacidade de dialogar com engenharia sobre integrações, limitações técnicas e impactos das decisões de produto.
  • Vivência em contextos que envolvam low code/no code, entendendo suas possibilidades, limitações e impactos na escalabilidade.
  • Capacidade de atuar em cenários híbridos: automação + processos tradicionais.
  • Forte orientação à experiência do usuário, com habilidade para mapear, analisar e evoluir jornadas complexas.
  • Experiência na construção, priorização e gestão de backlog, conectando objetivos de negócio, necessidades do usuário e viabilidade técnica.
  • Perfil analítico, com facilidade para transformar problemas de negócio em soluções de jornadas que geram experiência e eficiência para as empresas.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de apoio à construção de jornadas, como Miro, ou similares.


Seria legal se você tivesse


  • Vivência em ambiente de Desenvolvimento de Software.


Localidade | Atuação


Uberlândia/MG: Híbrido

Demais localidades: Remoto


Informações adicionais


Na Neppo , prezamos muito pelo equilíbrio entre o lado profissional e pessoal. Sabemos que hoje tudo é interligado e, no fim das contas, é tudo sobre gente . Por isso, nossos benefícios são personalizados para Neppers , confira:


⏱Horários Flexíveis

title: Senior Integration Engineer - Embedded Analytics (Multi-Tenant SaaS)
description:
Our US-based client is looking for a full-time, remote Senior Integration Engineer - Embedded Analytics (Multi-Tenant SaaS) with 7+ years of experience. The role focuses on designing and building the backend services and integrations that enable secure, scalable, multi-tenant embedded analytics within a SaaS platform.


This role sits at the intersection of application engineering, identity management, and the data platform. The primary focus is on integrating embedded analytics tools into a multi-tenant application with strict tenant isolation, SSO-based access control, and high-concurrency usage patterns.

While AWS QuickSight is the primary BI platform, we are open to candidates with experience embedding other modern, multi-tenant analytics solutions (such as Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Mode, or Superset). The emphasis is on a strong understanding of how embedded analytics work in SaaS environments, rather than on expertise in a single tool.

This is a senior-level role with meaningful influence over analytics architecture, security considerations, and integration standards across the platform.

Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class Property Management System integrating booking, guest communications, and financial reporting systems - all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities

  • Design and implement multi-tenant embedded analytics within customer-facing SaaS applications
  • Build backend services that generate and manage embed sessions, URLs, and permissions dynamically per tenant and user
  • Implement SSO and identity propagation (Auth0, Cognito, OIDC) to enforce tenant-aware access and role-based controls
  • Ensure row-level and dataset-level security is consistently applied across embedded analytics experiences
  • Partner with Analytics Engineers to align datasets, semantic models, and RLS logic with application roles
  • Translate analytics platform constraints into clean, reliable application-facing abstractions
  • Design and maintain tenant-aware APIs that abstract analytics tools behind stable, versioned interfaces
  • Build service-layer patterns that isolate application code from direct BI or warehouse dependencies
  • Implement caching, pagination, throttling, and batching strategies for high-concurrency analytics traffic
  • Ensure APIs gracefully handle tenant onboarding/offboarding and evolving analytics assets
  • Collaborate with the Data Platform Architect to design scalable backend patterns supporting hundreds of tenants
  • Optimize service-to-warehouse and service-to-analytics-tool interactions for latency and cost efficiency
  • Identify and mitigate failure modes in embedded analytics workflows (timeouts, permission drift, stale sessions)
  • Contribute to architecture documentation, integration diagrams, and design reviews
  • Enforce least-privilege access and tenant isolation across all analytics integrations
  • Ensure compliance with PII, data governance, and audit requirements in embedded reporting flows
  • Implement logging and audit trails for analytics access and permission changes
  • Partner with InfoSec to support security reviews and compliance initiatives
  • Implement CI/CD pipelines for integration services and analytics-related configuration
  • Contribute to infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or CloudFormation)
  • Support observability through CloudWatch, Datadog, or OpenTelemetry
  • Improve operational reliability through monitoring, alerting, and runbook development
  • Act as a technical owner for embedded analytics integrations
  • Partner with Product to shape analytics capabilities and roadmap decisions
  • Mentor mid-level engineers on integration patterns, security, and service design
  • Drive standards for analytics integration consistency and developer experience


Required Experience:

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 7+ years of backend or integration engineering experience in SaaS environments
  • Strong experience building backend services in Node.js, Python, or PHP
  • Hands-on experience embedding analytics or BI tools into multi-tenant applications
  • Strong understanding of SSO, OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and identity propagation
  • Experience implementing tenant-aware access controls (RLS, role mapping, dataset isolation)
  • Solid SQL knowledge and experience integrating with data warehouses
  • Proven experience with CI/CD pipelines and cloud-native deployment (AWS or equivalent)


Desired Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or some technical engineering
  • Experience embedding AWS QuickSight in multi-tenant SaaS applications
  • Experience with other embedded analytics platforms (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Superset, Mode, etc.)
  • Familiarity with row-level security models and permission orchestration
  • Experience with Auth0 or Cognito in analytics contexts.
  • Knowledge of caching layers (Redis) and high-concurrency API design
  • Exposure to data governance, lineage, or analytics access auditing


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Senior C/C++ engineer with Python
description:
Project Description:

Founded in 1984, our client is one of the world's leading provider of lithography systems for the semiconductor industry, manufacturing complex machines that are critical to the production of integrated circuits or chips. The client has its R&D and manufacturing operations in The Netherlands.

Luxoft is currently searching to augment the Development & Engineering Department with a talented software engineer to design and implement embedded software for systems among the highest precision ever produced in the world.


Responsibilities:

  • As a software engineer, you will be working on Linux server applications for metrology components and on complex algorithms application software. You will be working with electrical engineers, mechatronic engineers and system engineers to define the software requirements.
  • A team of about 10 people consisting of a team lead, a sw architect, a few senior developers. After your SW design is approved you are responsible for implementing the design in Python & C for new modules.
  • During testing, you will collect the necessary data so you can write a test report.
  • The development environment is Red Hat Linux, execution environment is Wind River Linux. The software release driving a client machine is 40 million lines of code. Client SW teams work in various modes such as Agile and SAFE.


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • We are looking for colleagues with at least 5 years of development experience.
  • Python: application coding
  • Linux (one of more of the following): familiar with command line tools, makefile, git, shell and python scripting
  • Embedded C and C++: understanding and maintaining legacy code. Adding new features while keeping compliance with established architecture.
  • Version control using command line is also required - Git, Clear Case and SVN, in this order of priority.


Languages:

  • English: C1 Advanced

The Role

Perseus is growing the Business Development team within our M&A group. This role will be primarily focused on covering the Brazilian software market. The successful candidate must be based in Brazil.

The role is to build strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. Relationships will be formed with decision makers (i.e. CEOs/VPs of Corporate Development/founders/owners) of software companies globally, M&A advisors, and private equity/venture capital professionals. Success is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships, having clients sign LOI’s and ultimately, the acquisition of software companies/assets by Perseus/Constellation.

Initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately being considered and chosen to be acquired by Perseus/Constellation typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/relationships and high-quality market research is what ultimately generates successful acquisitions through time.


Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s)
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.
  • Have a meaningful impact on Perseus Group over a successful tenure in-role


Relevant Experience & Competencies:

title: Senior Integration Engineer - Embedded Analytics (Multi-Tenant SaaS)
description:
Our US-based client is looking for a full-time, remote Senior Integration Engineer - Embedded Analytics (Multi-Tenant SaaS) with 7+ years of experience. The role focuses on designing and building the backend services and integrations that enable secure, scalable, multi-tenant embedded analytics within a SaaS platform.


This role sits at the intersection of application engineering, identity management, and the data platform. The primary focus is on integrating embedded analytics tools into a multi-tenant application with strict tenant isolation, SSO-based access control, and high-concurrency usage patterns.

While AWS QuickSight is the primary BI platform, we are open to candidates with experience embedding other modern, multi-tenant analytics solutions (such as Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Mode, or Superset). The emphasis is on a strong understanding of how embedded analytics work in SaaS environments, rather than on expertise in a single tool.

This is a senior-level role with meaningful influence over analytics architecture, security considerations, and integration standards across the platform.

Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class Property Management System integrating booking, guest communications, and financial reporting systems - all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities

  • Design and implement multi-tenant embedded analytics within customer-facing SaaS applications
  • Build backend services that generate and manage embed sessions, URLs, and permissions dynamically per tenant and user
  • Implement SSO and identity propagation (Auth0, Cognito, OIDC) to enforce tenant-aware access and role-based controls
  • Ensure row-level and dataset-level security is consistently applied across embedded analytics experiences
  • Partner with Analytics Engineers to align datasets, semantic models, and RLS logic with application roles
  • Translate analytics platform constraints into clean, reliable application-facing abstractions
  • Design and maintain tenant-aware APIs that abstract analytics tools behind stable, versioned interfaces
  • Build service-layer patterns that isolate application code from direct BI or warehouse dependencies
  • Implement caching, pagination, throttling, and batching strategies for high-concurrency analytics traffic
  • Ensure APIs gracefully handle tenant onboarding/offboarding and evolving analytics assets
  • Collaborate with the Data Platform Architect to design scalable backend patterns supporting hundreds of tenants
  • Optimize service-to-warehouse and service-to-analytics-tool interactions for latency and cost efficiency
  • Identify and mitigate failure modes in embedded analytics workflows (timeouts, permission drift, stale sessions)
  • Contribute to architecture documentation, integration diagrams, and design reviews
  • Enforce least-privilege access and tenant isolation across all analytics integrations
  • Ensure compliance with PII, data governance, and audit requirements in embedded reporting flows
  • Implement logging and audit trails for analytics access and permission changes
  • Partner with InfoSec to support security reviews and compliance initiatives
  • Implement CI/CD pipelines for integration services and analytics-related configuration
  • Contribute to infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or CloudFormation)
  • Support observability through CloudWatch, Datadog, or OpenTelemetry
  • Improve operational reliability through monitoring, alerting, and runbook development
  • Act as a technical owner for embedded analytics integrations
  • Partner with Product to shape analytics capabilities and roadmap decisions
  • Mentor mid-level engineers on integration patterns, security, and service design
  • Drive standards for analytics integration consistency and developer experience


Required Experience:

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 7+ years of backend or integration engineering experience in SaaS environments
  • Strong experience building backend services in Node.js, Python, or PHP
  • Hands-on experience embedding analytics or BI tools into multi-tenant applications
  • Strong understanding of SSO, OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and identity propagation
  • Experience implementing tenant-aware access controls (RLS, role mapping, dataset isolation)
  • Solid SQL knowledge and experience integrating with data warehouses
  • Proven experience with CI/CD pipelines and cloud-native deployment (AWS or equivalent)


Desired Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or some technical engineering
  • Experience embedding AWS QuickSight in multi-tenant SaaS applications
  • Experience with other embedded analytics platforms (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Superset, Mode, etc.)
  • Familiarity with row-level security models and permission orchestration
  • Experience with Auth0 or Cognito in analytics contexts.
  • Knowledge of caching layers (Redis) and high-concurrency API design
  • Exposure to data governance, lineage, or analytics access auditing


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Engenheiro de dados - Líder Técnico
description:
A VMBears é uma empresa jovem e moderna com o objetivo de ajudar seus clientes a aproveitar novas tecnologias para acelerar seus negócios. Fornece serviços de consultoria para arquitetura corporativa e modernização de sistemas para nuvem. Fundada em 2018, possui em seu DNA a ética, a positividade, o comprometimento e a inovação. Somos focados em oferecer os melhores serviços prestados através dos melhores profissionais do mercado. Esses recursos são utilizados para auxiliar os clientes em sua jornada de modernização tecnológica e transformação digital.


O que buscamos?

O Engenheiro(a) de Dados é o profissional que constrói e mantém a infraestrutura responsável por mover, transformar e disponibilizar dados com confiabilidade e performance. Um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados eficaz domina pipelines batch + streaming, otimiza consultas em data-warehouses colunares e garante a rastreabilidade ponta-a-ponta de cada registro. Na prática, atua como elo entre arquitetura e desenvolvimento, permanecendo intrinsecamente ligado(a) ao código que sustenta o fluxo de informações.


Na VMBears, o Engenheiro(a) de Dados é o(a) guardião(ã) da qualidade dos dados: projeta pipelines escaláveis, monitora sua saúde em produção e antecipa gargalos. Para este projeto, a modernização de um motor de cálculo de alto volume no setor de energia, buscamos alguém que una profundidade técnica em processamento distribuído e lakehouse a uma mentalidade de produto baseada em dados.


Você integrará o squad que modernizará o Motor de Cálculo, um engine que processa bilhões de registros, aplica centenas de fórmulas regulatórias e gera resultados contábeis que movem o mercado de energia elétrica. Procuramos alguém que combine habilidade de modelar dados massivos com espírito de colaboração, ajudando o time a migrar de um monolito PL/SQL para uma plataforma distribuída, event-driven e cloud-native, onde cada byte chegue rápido, íntegro e auditável ao novo motor.


Responsabilidades:

  • Implementar soluções com arquitetura de dados distribuída, garantindo latência e throughput que atendam aos requisitos da do negócio;
  • Implantar pipelines de ingestão, transformação e publicação que suportem batch + streaming em larga escala;
  • Desenvolver jobs Spark/Flink e para data-warehouses colunares;
  • Seguir padrões de versionamento, catalogação e lineage de dados para rastreabilidade de processamento;
  • Desenvolver processos sempre visando o menor custo e maior performance em Redshift/BigQuery/Athena, propondo ajustes de partição, compressão e caching;
  • Documentar processos e fluxos de trabalho de dados: Manter registros detalhados dos processos de dados para facilitar a manutenção e a melhoria contínua;
  • Projetar sistemas que possam crescer conforme a demanda por dados aumenta.


Stack desejável:

  • Redshift, BigQuery, Snowflake, Athena, Iceberg, Delta Lake;
  • Spark (DataFrames, Structured Streaming), Flink, EMR, Dataproc, Databricks, Hadoop (YARN, HDFS);
  • Apache NiFi, Kafka Connect, AWS DMS, Kafka, Kinesis, Pub/Sub;
  • Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, OpenTelemetry, DataHub, Great Expectations;
  • Terraform/IaC, CI/CD Git, testes de dados automatizados, segurança LGPD (IAM fine-grained, encryption at rest/in transit).


Requisitos imprescindíveis:

  • Formação em Ciência da Computação ou área relacionada;
  • Experiência comprovada como Engenheiro de Dados: Ter um histórico sólido na área de engenharia de dados. Pensamento lógico e solução de problemas complexos.
  • Proficiência em alguma linguagem de programação (Python, Java e outras) e SQL: Ser capaz de usar essas linguagens de programação para manipular e gerenciar dados.
  • Conhecimento em tecnologias de big data: Familiaridade com ferramentas que permitem o processamento de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Experiência com sistemas de gerenciamento de banco de dados: Saber como projetar e manter bancos de dados eficientes. Organização para gerenciar grandes volumes de dados e processos críticos.
  • Habilidades de resolução de problemas e pensamento analítico: Capacidade de identificar e resolver problemas complexos de dados. Habilidade de documentação e boas práticas em arquitetura de dados.


Segue abaixo os benefícios oferecidos:

  • Auxílio home-office;
  • Nossa forma de trabalho é totalmente home-office permitindo que você esteja sempre perto de quem mais importa;
  • Descontos em academias através do Total Pass;
  • Desenvolvimento profissional aqui é primordial, por isso oferecemos um programa de capacitação online onde você recebe R$300,00 de crédito semestralmente para adquirir cursos na plataforma Udemy;

Não se trata apenas de experiência executiva, mas de vivência comprovada na liderança de organizações inseridas nos setores onde a Bizup constrói sua autoridade e diferenciação competitiva. Buscamos profissionais que tenham tomado decisões críticas de crescimento, reestruturação, posicionamento e alocação de capital dentro dessas indústrias, compreendendo profundamente suas dinâmicas competitivas, cadeias de valor, desafios regulatórios e vetores de transformação.

Ser Associado representa o início da jornada para tornar-se sócio da Bizup Strategy e requer qualificações que permitam desempenhar atividades de prospecção de oportunidades, geração estruturada de conhecimento setorial e liderança na execução de projetos estratégicos. title: Cientista de Dados - Sênior
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?

Então essa é a sua chance!



Buscamos: Cientista de Dados - Sênior



Resumo: Atuar como referência técnica e analítica na estruturação, evolução e confiabilidade dos dados de Ad Intelligence, transformando grandes volumes de dados complexos em insights estratégicos que apoiem decisões de negócio, desenvolvimento de produto e melhoria contínua dos processos operacionais. O cargo combina excelência técnica em Data Science com forte entendimento de mídia, metodologia e negócio, atuando como elo entre Dados, Produto, Operações e áreas comerciais, garantindo que o dado seja consistente, confiável, relevante e acionável para o mercado.



Responsabilidades:

  • Estruturar, desenvolver e evoluir metodologias analíticas e modelos de dados aplicados aos produtos de Ad Intelligence, assegurando consistência, robustez e aderência às necessidades do mercado.
  • Conduzir análises aprofundadas de dados para identificar padrões, tendências, anomalias, riscos metodológicos e oportunidades de melhoria nos produtos, processos e entregas.
  • Desenvolver e testar hipóteses de negócio por meio de abordagens quantitativas, apoiando decisões estratégicas e táticas.
  • Atuar como consultor interno para as áreas de Produto, Operações, Taxonomia, Comercial e Liderança, traduzindo dados complexos em recomendações claras e acionáveis.
  • Automatizar análises, relatórios e fluxos de dados, aumentando eficiência operacional, escalabilidade e confiabilidade das entregas.
  • Monitorar continuamente a qualidade, cobertura e consistência dos dados, identificando e investigando desvios, gaps e comportamentos atípicos.
  • Contribuir para a evolução do conhecimento analítico e metodológico da empresa, por meio de documentação, treinamentos, apresentações e troca ativa com outros times.
  • Participar de interações com clientes e fornecedores quando necessário, explicando metodologias, análises e implicações dos dados de forma clara e transparente.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre tendências em mídia, digital, cross-media, Data Science e Analytics, propondo inovações aplicáveis ao contexto da Kantar.



Conhecimento Essencial:

  • Forte experiência em análise de dados, modelagem estatística e Data Science.
  • Domínio de Python e/ou R e SQL.
  • Inglês avançado.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de visualização (Power BI, Tableau ou similares).
  • Experiência com grandes volumes de dados e pipelines analíticos.
  • Capacidade de traduzir problemas de negócio em problemas analíticos e vice-versa.
  • Comunicação clara, didática e colaborativa.



Conhecimento Desejável:

  • Conhecimento de ambientes de cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP).
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis.
  • Conhecimento específico de mídia digital, cross-media, CTV, VOD.
  • Entendimento de mídia, publicidade e métricas de investimento (ou capacidade de aprender rapidamente).

title: Especialista em Contabilidade de Carbono e Certificações
description:
OBJETIVO

Integrar a equipe técnica do Instituto E+ com foco em contabilidade de carbono e certificações, atuando de forma transversal nas agendas de descarbonização industrial e bioeconomia. Este cargo combina atuação técnica e institucional, incluindo interlocução com poder público, setor produtivo e demais stakeholders na temática de mercado de carbono e instrumentos correlatos.

Buscamos uma pessoa com sólida base técnica em contabilidade de GEE, metodologias internacionais e sistemas de certificação, com capacidade de análise regulatória e atuação instituciona l. Será responsável por desenhar arquiteturas avançadas de GenAI e Agentic AI, estabelecer padrões corporativos, definir protocolos de comunicação entre agentes (A2A) e liderar a adoção de protocolos modernos de IA Generativa, como o Model Context Protocol (MCP), garantindo escalabilidade, segurança, governança e eficiência operacional em nível enterprise.


O que vai fazer

- Comunicação Agent-to-Agent (A2A);

title: Remote Biomedical Informatics SME - 58854
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

We are seeking highly skilled Biomedical Informatics Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to join our team in developing rigorous, high-quality evaluation questions designed to assess and challenge advanced AI models. The primary objective is to create benchmark questions that test the boundaries of AI capabilities across diverse bioinformatics domains.

This role requires deep technical expertise combined with the ability to craft precise, unambiguous questions with well-defined evaluations. The ideal candidate will possess not only strong theoretical knowledge but also practical experience in designing assessment materials that have deterministic, verifiable outcomes.


Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop challenging bioinformatics coding questions that push the limits of AI model capabilities.
  • Create automated, coding-based evaluations with unit tests that objectively verify correctness.
  • Build comprehensive evaluation rubrics with 7–10 distinct criteria for each bioinformatics question.
  • Ensure every question is self-contained, well-defined, and completely unambiguous, including all domain rules and edge cases.
  • Develop problems where there is exactly one correct answer or outcome that can be deterministically validated.
  • Translate theoretical bioinformatics concepts into concrete, measurable outputs.
  • Enforce performance requirements with explicit constraints and tests to prevent inefficient or brute-force solutions.


Required Qualifications:

Educational Background

  • Master's degree of experience in biomedical data processing and interpretation.
  • Ongoing PhD with 3+ years of experience in biomedical data processing and interpretation.
  • PhD (completed) in Biomedical Informatics, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology or a closely related field (preferred).


Technical and other skills
